title: Podcast Producer & Marketer

title: Experienced DTC Meta Ai Video Editor  (ULTRA REALISTIC)
description:
Here is a tailored, high-performance job description designed to attract elite AI video editors and creative specialists capable of executing ultra-realistic product integration, intricate AI UGC, and high-volume direct-response concepts.



QUICK SUMMARY

Daily Output: At least 3 concepts per day (averaging 2 minutes each), including revisions.



Focus: Ultra-high-level direct-response product ads leveraging advanced AI video generation, hyper-realistic AI UGC, and intricate product integration.



Location: Remote



Compensation: $1,500/month flat base retainer + high-performance winning ad bonuses.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an elite, world-class AI Video Editor & Creative Specialist who operates at the absolute cutting edge of artificial intelligence and direct-response advertising.



This role is not for basic prompt-and-pray creators. We need someone who can execute the most intricate, complex AI workflows in the industry—from generating hyper-realistic AI UGC showing products being actively applied, worn, or interacted with, to seamlessly blending synthetic elements into live-action footage so they are entirely indistinguishable from reality.



You understand direct-response psychology, retention editing, pacing, and the nuances of high-converting Meta and TikTok ad creatives. Speed is critical, but realism, physical accuracy, and conversion quality are non-negotiable.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

High-Volume Concept Production: Deliver at least 3 distinct, fully polished ad concepts daily (approx. 2 minutes per video), including all revisions and iterations based on performance feedback.



Ultra-Realistic AI UGC & Product Interaction: Create flawless AI characters and UGC creators that look, move, and speak with human realism. Execute complex interactions such as applying skincare/products, unboxing, wearing items, and handling objects with zero physical artifacts.



Advanced AI Video & B-Roll Generation: Utilize state-of-the-art video models (Runway Gen-3/4, Kling, Luma) to produce cinematic, clean-lighting, texturally accurate b-roll and scene extensions that integrate invisibly into real-world footage.



Character, Voice, & Lip-Sync Mastery: Direct and manage hyper-realistic AI talking heads, precise lip-syncing, emotional delivery, and nuanced accent distinction (British/American).



End-to-End Post-Production: Handle scripting support, prompt engineering, compositing, upscaling (Topaz), sound design, colour grading, pacing, and final export delivery across Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKIC-K (YOUR STACK)

You must already be a power user across most of the following tools:



AI Video: Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4, Kling, Luma Dream Machine, LTX Studio, or equivalent advanced motion models.



Voice / Character: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, D-ID, or custom pipeline equivalents.



Image Generation: Midjourney v6+, Leonardo.ai, Stable Diffusion (ControlNet/IP-Adapter for product consistency).



Editing Suite: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



Enhancement: Topaz Video AI.



REQUIREMENTS & STANDARDS

Obsessive Attention to Detail: You must instantly spot and fix distorted fingers, floating objects, unnatural lighting, warping textures, awkward lip-syncing, or dead emotion. If it looks "AI-generated," it doesn't ship.



Direct-Response Fluency: Deep understanding of hooks, visual retention triggers, emotional arcs, and what makes high-ticket or DTC products convert on paid social.



Exceptional Speed & Output: Proven ability to maintain a blistering daily pace (3+ concepts/day at 2 minutes each) without sacrificing technical or visual quality.



Audio & Accent Awareness: Flawless English comprehension with the ability to direct and refine voice deliveries, pacing, and regional accents (UK/US).



COMPENSATION & BONUSES

Base Salary: $1,500 per month



Performance Bonuses:



$200 Bonus: Any winning ad spending over $200/day at a 1.8+ ROAS.



$1,000 Bonus: Any winning ad spending $1,000/day at a 2.0+ ROAS.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work, product ad creatives, and complex AI UGC.



Direct examples of intricate product interaction/application generated via AI.



A list of the AI tools and versions you currently use or pay for regularly.



Application Requirement:

To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word: NEURAL

title: Media Buyer
description:
MEDIA BUYER



Direct Response | Performance-Focused

Full-Time | Remote



We are a fast-growing Singapore property investment education company looking for a performance-driven Media Buyer to join our team.



About Proptiply™

Proptiply™ iis a Singapore-based real estate education platform that helps Singaporeans make smarter property investment and real estate decisions.



We educate through webinars, live bootcamps and mentoring programmes, combining practical knowledge with real-world property insights.



We are growing rapidly and looking for a Media Buyer to help us reach more people, generate quality leads and scale our programmes.



Why This Role Is Different



This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

• Real conversion campaigns

• Meaningful daily advertising spend

• Funnels where your decisions have a direct impact on performance



You’ll follow proven SOPs, but you’ll also be trusted to make sound judgment calls when campaign performance requires it.

If you want to grow quickly by working close to real data, real advertising spend and real business decisions, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

• Run and optimise conversion-focused paid advertising campaigns, primarily on Meta, with YouTube as the next platform

• Monitor campaign performance and identify potential issues early

• Take ownership of campaign health, not just campaign execution

• Follow established SOPs while making informed adjustments when necessary

• Escalate performance issues and opportunities to the Ops Manager

• Participate in scheduled weekend monitoring for selected high-spend campaigns

• Join structured ad setup and implementation sessions for Proptiply™ webinars, programmes and campaign launches.

• Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, consistently and according to agreed performance standards



You’ll mainly receive priorities and inputs from a single Ops Manager, allowing you to stay focused without unnecessary stakeholder or creative chaos.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For



You will not be expected to:

• Write advertising copy

• Design creatives

• Redesign funnels, offers or pricing

• Handle client communication

• Manage client accounts

• Juggle multiple stakeholders or unclear priorities



Your primary focus is campaign performance and campaign health, with clear responsibilities and structured processes.



Who This Role Is For

This role could be a strong fit if you:

• Have hands-on experience running conversion-focused advertising campaigns for leads or sales

• Are comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

• Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move quickly

• Respect processes and structure without freezing when conditions change

• Communicate clearly and proactively

• Take ownership seriously

• Enjoy working with numbers, data and performance metrics

• Want to improve rapidly as a direct-response media buyer



Who This Role Is NOT For

This role may not be suitable for:

• “Set-and-forget” ad managers

• Freelancers simultaneously managing multiple client accounts

• People looking for a low-pressure, purely 9-to-5 role

• Anyone uncomfortable taking responsibility for campaigns involving significant advertising spend

• People who prefer simply following instructions without thinking about performance



Compensation & Growth

At Proptiply™, compensation is more than just a monthly paycheck.

You’ll be operating in an ecosystem where:

• Six figures are spent on paid advertising every month

• Multiple six figures are invested yearly into business growth, operations, education, health and performance

• Decisions are made using real data, real risk and real outcomes



What This Means for You

You’ll gain:

• Exposure to high-spend direct-response campaigns

• Experience with advanced media buying and direct-response practices

• Opportunities to develop beyond advertising into business thinking, systems and performance management

• Direct exposure to the decision-making behind campaign scaling and optimisation

• Performance bonuses for strong execution, judgment and results



If you’re looking for comfort, this probably isn’t the role for you.

If you’re looking to level up quickly, take responsibility and grow properly, you may thrive here.



How to Apply



Please complete the application form carefully.

The questions are designed to help us understand how you think, not simply which advertising tools you have used.



Apply here:





Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for media buyers who:

• Respect structure

• Protect campaign performance

• Think critically

• Take ownership seriously

• Want to keep improving

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Being able to learn new software is a major part of this job. You should be comfortable watching tutorials, testing different settings and figuring out how to get the result I’m asking for. You need strong editing skills from the start and the ability to pick up unfamiliar tools along the way.



The work may include recreating a reference video with a different person, product, voice or background, creating AI clips and voiceovers, and editing everything together so it looks and sounds natural.



You should already know CapCut well, including cuts, timing, captions, audio and layers. Details matter, especially when matching a reference or keeping the product, background and camera angle consistent.



Check your work for incorrect captions, awkward cuts, audio issues and unrealistic AI details before sending it over. You’ll also make revisions based on my feedback.



Good English comprehension and clear communication are important. If something in the instructions is unclear, ask. Experience with e-commerce ads or UGC-style videos is a plus.



To apply, send:



1. Two or three relevant videos you’ve worked on and what you handled.

2. Which editing and AI tools you’ve used.

3. An example of a tool you learned on your own and what you made with it.

4. When you can start.



If you have a reference video alongside the version you created, include both.



Pay: $4 USD per hour + commission

Hours: 6 hours per day, 6 days per week, for a total of 36 hours per week.

title: SENIOR Art Director
description:
Luxury Fashion | Global Brand | Australia-Based



The Opportunity



We’re seeking an exceptional SENIOR Art Director to join a fast-paced, creatively ambitious team at an Australian-based luxury fashion brand with a global presence.



This is an opportunity for a highly experienced, agency-trained creative with a strong visual point of view, a refined understanding of luxury, and a portfolio spanning top-tier clients, campaigns and creative projects.



You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping and elevating the brand’s visual identity across global touch points, bringing together fashion, culture, art direction and commercial creativity to deliver work that is distinctive, considered and world-class.



Working in a high-performance environment, you’ll collaborate with a passionate team to translate brand vision into compelling creative, balancing conceptual thinking with exceptional execution.



The role is Australian-based, working local hours within the Australian time zone, collaborating with a global brand and its international audience.



About the Role



As Senior Art Director, you’ll lead the development and execution of creative concepts across a rebrand, then roll out campaigns, brand storytelling, web and digital, social, editorial and full scope brand experiences.



You’ll bring the creative rigour and pace of a leading agency environment, combined with an instinctive understanding of luxury aesthetics, fashion imagery and the details that distinguish premium creative from the ordinary.



From the initial concept through to final delivery, you’ll champion creative excellence, maintain consistency across brand touch points and push the boundaries of how the brand shows up in the world.



Key Responsibilities



- Creative Direction & Concept Development: Develop distinctive, culturally relevant creative concepts that elevate brand perception and reinforce a compelling global identity.

- Campaign Art Direction: Lead visual development across fashion campaigns, editorial shoots, brand content and integrated creative projects.

- Visual Storytelling: Bring a sophisticated understanding of imagery, typography, composition, colour and design to every creative output.

- Brand Consistency: Uphold and evolve the brand’s visual codes across digital, social, e-commerce, print and campaign environments.

- Shoot Direction: Collaborate with photographers, stylists, talent, producers and creative partners to deliver exceptional visual outcomes.

- Creative Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams and external agencies to translate strategic objectives into ambitious, high-quality creative.

- Executional Excellence: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining exceptional standards while working to demanding timelines.

- Creative Leadership:Bring clarity, confidence and creative rigour to the process, inspiring those around you and contributing to a culture of high standards.



About You



You are an agency-experienced Senior Art Director with a proven track record of delivering exceptional creative for recognised, top-tier clients. A cool mood board, unique eye and a history of artistic delivery. 



You combine conceptual strength with an elevated visual sensibility and understand how to build brands through powerful, cohesive and emotionally resonant creative.



You thrive in fast-moving environments where expectations are high, details matter and the work must consistently meet a world-class standard.



You are commercially aware without compromising creativity, confident presenting and defending your ideas, and comfortable navigating multiple stakeholders, projects and priorities.



What You Bring



- Significant experience as a Senior Art Director within a leading creative, advertising, fashion or branding agency.

- A standout portfolio of top-tier clients and high-calibre creative projects, demonstrating conceptual depth, visual sophistication and exceptional execution.

- A strong understanding of luxury fashion, premium brand positioning and contemporary visual culture.

- A distinctive creative point of view, with the ability to develop ideas that feel both original and strategically relevant.

- Proven experience art directing campaigns, shoots and multi-channel creative.

- A refined eye for detail and an instinctive understanding of what makes creative feel elevated, timeless and culturally resonant.

- The ability to move seamlessly between big-picture creative thinking and hands-on execution.

- Strong communication, presentation and collaboration skills.

- The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outstanding work in a fast-paced environment.

- A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a genuine appetite to raise the creative bar.



The Ideal Candidate



You have been shaped by the pace, standards and creative ambition of a leading agency environment. You know what exceptional looks like because you’ve helped create it.



Your portfolio speaks for itself: considered concepts, beautifully executed campaigns, ambitious projects and work for clients with high expectations. Web design and digital experience.



You understand that luxury is not simply an aesthetic. It’s a feeling, a perspective and an uncompromising attention to every detail.



You bring energy, curiosity and conviction to the work, thrive under pressure and are motivated by the opportunity to build something distinctive with a team that shares your ambition.



 Why Join Us?



- The opportunity to shape the creative expression of an Australian-based luxury fashion brand with global reach.

- A fast-paced, ambitious environment where creativity, quality and attention to detail are paramount.

- The opportunity to work across a diverse range of high-impact brand and campaign initiatives.

- Collaboration with a driven team operating at the intersection of fashion, culture and creative innovation.

- An opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the evolution of a global luxury brand, while working Australian local hours.



Apply



Essential for Application - Degree qualified in related field, Agency Experience, Portfolio of Rebrand Projects, Fashion and luxury industry experience preferred.



If you’re an agency-trained Senior Art Director an exceptional portfolio, a strong creative point of view and a passion for elevating luxury brands, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your CV (pdf) and portfolio link, highlighting the clients, campaigns and creative projects that best demonstrate your experience and capabilities.



We’re looking for exceptional creative talent with the ambition, judgement and craft to deliver work at the highest level. A unique point of view and artistry.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Property and lease administration: Maintain tenant and property records, prepare leases and renewals using approved templates, track signatures, and coordinate move-in and move-out requirements.

- Maintenance and utilities: Coordinate vendors, track repair requests through completion, monitor utility balances and due dates, and flag issues requiring attention or approval.

- QuickBooks Online bookkeeping: Process and categorize transactions, prepare invoices, track receivables and payables, reconcile accounts, and prepare monthly financial reports. Maintain supporting documentation and investigate discrepancies.

- DoorLoop administration: Keep property, tenant, lease, charge, payment, deposit, and maintenance records accurate and current.

- Task coordination and reporting: Maintain shared trackers, follow up on outstanding requests, coordinate assigned staff or vendors, and provide concise updates on progress, deadlines, and unresolved issues.

- Process improvement: Document procedures and identify practical ways to reduce errors, improve efficiency, and strengthen follow-through.

You must bring:

- Proven experience in property management or property operations, including long-term rentals and short-term rental coordination.

- Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, bank and credit card reconciliations, and financial reporting.

- Practical DoorLoop experience, including maintaining tenant and lease records, reviewing charges and payments, and tracking maintenance.

- Strong spreadsheet, document organization, and written communication skills.

title: VA - Guest Communication & Operations @ Restay Homes
description:
Hi!



My name is Nikita, I'm the founder of Restay Vacation Homes Rental - a short-term rental management company based in Dubai.



We manage 35+ furnished apartments in Dubai under sublease and property management, from studios to 3-bedrooms. We've held Airbnb Superhost status for the past year with a 4.8-4.9 rating across the whole portfolio, and we're adding units every month.



We're looking for one more VA to join our operations team.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

- 6+ months in a small team or startup

- Experience helping a company scale from 10 to 50+ units is a big plus

- Familiarity with guest communication, pricing tools, turnover coordination

- Experience writing SOPs or building team processes



WHAT WE OFFER



- $4-6/hour depending on experience

- Flexible workload, 40-60 hrs/week, 5-6 days - you tell us what suits you

- Direct work with the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Opportunity to grow into Team Lead as we scale



HOW TO APPLY



We don't accept direct messages. Applications without a completed form are ignored.



The application has two parts:



Part 1 - a short form about you and your experience (about 10 minutes)

Part 2 - five real situations from our operations. You'll get the link right after you submit Part 1. You have 60 minutes from that moment, and we record how long it takes.



Part 2 has no trick questions and no perfect answers. We want to see how you think and how fast you get to a result.



Form:



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Nikita

title: Copywriter
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You'll write the copy that sits at the center of our growth. It's work that goes live quickly and is measured by real results, so you'll know what worked within days.



For a gifted writer who's fascinated by persuasion and wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of the voice of a growing brand.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Write words that move people. Stories and copy that pull a skeptical reader in, build belief, and move them to act. You'll lead with the angle, the hook, and the proof that earn the click and the order.



Script video that holds attention. Write the scripts for the videos that carry our brand: the hook in the first seconds, the story that keeps people watching, and the line that closes it.



Own the brand voice. Make Cellexia Labs sound like itself everywhere a customer meets us: confident, clear, and credible.



Turn insight into messaging. Dig into customer reviews, support conversations, and ingredient science to find the language customers actually use, then build every piece around it.



Make complex things simple. Take formulation details and ingredient science and turn them into benefits a customer understands in seconds, while staying accurate and compliant.



Test relentlessly. Ship variations of angles, hooks, and openings, read the results with the marketing team, and double down on what wins. Your best work is the work the data backs.



What we look for



Command of the craft. You write sharply and clearly, and you can tell a line that lands from one that merely sounds good. You edit your own work hard.



A pull toward persuasion. You're fascinated by what makes people say yes: the customer's doubts, the offer, the proof, the words that earn trust. You don't need a background in sales or persuasion. You need real curiosity about how words move people, and the drive to learn from what the numbers tell you.



Ownership. You treat every piece of copy as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Curiosity. You research before you write. You're willing to understand ingredients, customers, and competitors until the words come from real understanding.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years of professional writing, with a portfolio that shows it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or other consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. You'll never wait on a chain of sign-offs. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Copy goes live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your words move the numbers.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the writer who shapes our voice is the writer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist / Team Lead
description:
Full-Time · Remote · Worldwide · E-commerce



We’re looking for someone to take ownership of customer support at a fast-growing international e-commerce company.



At Anodys, we build and scale consumer products across dozens of international markets.



Our business is growing quickly, and we currently receive approximately 300 customer support tickets per day across our online stores.



We already have:



* An established customer support platform (Commslayer)

* AI agents handling approximately 60% of incoming tickets

* Existing SOPs and support processes

* Automated translation across international markets

* A technical team responsible for AI development and integrations

* An operations team overseeing the broader business



What we’re missing is an exceptional person to take ownership of day-to-day customer support.



Someone who handles customers brilliantly, moves fast, solves problems independently, improves processes, and eventually helps us build a small, highly effective support team.



This is not a role where you’ll spend your day waiting for instructions.



We want someone who sees a problem and fixes it.



What you’ll own



1. Customer Support



You’ll initially be very hands-on.



You’ll handle customer conversations involving:



* Order tracking and delivery questions

* Refunds and returns

* Cancellations and order changes

* Missing, damaged, or incorrect products

* Product questions

* Complaints and escalations

* Other customer issues across our stores



We expect fast, clear, professional communication and genuine problem-solving.



You’ll have SOPs to work from, but we want someone who can think independently rather than blindly follow scripts.



2. Support Operations



You’ll help ensure that our customer support operation runs smoothly.



This includes:



* Managing the daily ticket queue

* Prioritizing urgent cases

* Preventing ticket backlogs

* Monitoring response and resolution times

* Identifying recurring problems

* Improving existing SOPs

* Maintaining consistent support quality

* Escalating operational issues to the right people

* Reporting important trends to management



We don’t want someone who just closes tickets.



We want someone who notices why tickets keep appearing and helps eliminate the underlying problems.



3. AI Support Quality



Our AI agents already handle a large portion of customer conversations.



You won’t be responsible for building the AI systems from scratch. We have a technical team and Head of Operations handling that.



However, you’ll help improve the system by:



* Reviewing AI conversations

* Identifying incorrect or unhelpful responses

* Spotting situations where AI should escalate to a human

* Reporting missing information or broken workflows

* Suggesting improvements to our knowledge base and SOPs

* Working with our operations and technical teams to improve automation quality



The goal is to automate more support without sacrificing customer experience.



4. Customer Feedback & Reporting



We want someone who can turn customer conversations into useful business insights.



For example:



If customers repeatedly complain about a specific product, shipping issue, confusing offer, or checkout experience, we want you to identify the pattern and report it.



You’ll help us understand:



* Why customers contact support

* Which products generate the most complaints

* Why customers request refunds

* Where delivery problems occur

* Which support processes create unnecessary friction

* What could be improved across the business



You don’t need to be a data scientist.



But you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, basic reporting, and support metrics.



5. Team Leadership



As the business grows, you may help:



* Recruit additional support agents

* Train new hires

* Review their work

* Maintain quality standards

* Organize shifts and coverage

* Manage support performance



We want someone who can grow into a Team Lead role if they prove themselves.



There may be opportunities for broader responsibility later, but we’re primarily hiring someone who can execute exceptionally well today.



Who we’re looking for



You should have:



* Strong experience in e-commerce customer support

* Excellent written English

* Experience handling significant ticket volumes

* Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms

* Experience with customer support software

* Strong judgment when handling refunds, complaints, and difficult customers

* Excellent organization and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Comfort using AI tools and automation

* Ability to identify operational improvements

* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset



Experience with Commslayer is a plus, but not required.



Experience managing or training other support agents is a major plus.



Experience with international e-commerce, logistics, fulfillment, refunds, and chargebacks is also valuable.



How we work



We’re a small, fast-moving, international team.



We value:



* Speed

* Ownership

* Clear communication

* Good judgment

* Independence

* Practical problem-solving

* Continuous improvement



We don’t have unnecessary meetings or complicated corporate processes.



We give capable people responsibility and expect them to deliver.



If you need constant supervision, this probably isn’t the right environment.



If you enjoy taking ownership and making things run better, you’ll likely enjoy working with us.



Working arrangement



* Full-time

* 100% remote

* Worldwide applicants welcome

* Excellent written English required

* Working hours and time-zone overlap to be agreed

* Some weekend coverage may be required through a planned team schedule

* Long-term opportunity

* Competitive fixed compensation based on experience and ability



We’re willing to pay well for someone exceptional.



What success looks like



Within your first month, we’d expect you to:



* Understand our stores, products, systems, and SOPs

* Take ownership of the human support queue

* Handle tickets efficiently and accurately

* Reduce unnecessary escalations

* Identify the most common customer complaints

* Establish clear support reporting

* Identify opportunities to improve AI responses

* Suggest practical improvements to our workflows

* Help us determine the right future staffing and coverage structure



Ultimately, we want customer support to become something that runs smoothly without constant management involvement.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions directly. Generic applications will not be considered.



1. Experience



Tell us about the largest e-commerce customer support operation you’ve personally worked in.



What type of business was it? How many tickets did you handle per day? What were your responsibilities?



2. Speed and workload



Imagine you start tomorrow and find 120 tickets requiring human attention.



How would you organize your day to handle them efficiently without sacrificing quality?



3. Difficult customer



Describe a real situation where you handled an angry customer or complicated refund request.



What happened, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



4. Problem-solving



Tell us about a recurring customer support problem you identified and helped solve.



We want an actual example, not a hypothetical one.



5. AI and automation



Our AI agents currently handle approximately 60% of tickets.



How would you evaluate whether the AI is doing a good job? What would you look for when reviewing conversations?



6. Reporting



What customer support metrics would you track weekly, and why?



7. Leadership



Have you ever trained, hired, or managed customer support agents?



If yes, tell us about your experience.



8. Practical scenario



A customer ordered a supplement three weeks ago. Tracking shows the package hasn’t moved for 12 days. The customer is angry and demands an immediate refund.



What exactly would you do?



9. First week



You join Monday.



We have multiple Shopify stores, approximately 300 tickets/day, existing SOPs, AI automation, and a technical team.



What would you aim to accomplish by Friday?



10. Availability and compensation



Please include:



* Your country and time zone

* Current employment situation

* Availability for full-time work

* Weekend availability

* Expected monthly compensation in USD

* Earliest possible start date



We’re looking for someone who wants to take real ownership, not just answer tickets.

French

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

-Independent contractor, not employment: written agreement and confidentiality agreement. You choose when and how you work, keep other clients, and invoice us.

-No list building and no manual dialling: checked prospects loaded into a power dialer that takes you from one call to the next, so your time goes into conversations.

-Australia and New Zealand business hours, which start around 4 am Philippine time.

-Results-based, with targets for logged calls and for qualified meetings the decision-maker attends. Use your own computer, smartphone, internet and headset; you do the work yourself.



Pay



US$140 per 14 days against the targets, plus a payment for every qualified meeting above target, with no cap. The dialer does the dialling; the meetings are where you earn more. Shortlisted applicants get the targets, the per-meeting rate and the agreements before anything is signed. Paid by Wise within 7 days of your invoice.

You



Proven outbound cold calling into Australia, New Zealand or a similar market, clear spoken English, careful with logging and compliance, and a Philippine TIN with your own self-employed practice.



To apply



Start with the word APPOINTMENT. Tell us your calling experience (countries, products, calls per day, meetings booked per week), and add a one-minute voice clip and your CV. Shortlisted applicants get a video interview with a short role-play call.



We use applications only for this engagement and delete unsuccessful ones within three months.

title: Part-Time Corporate Administrator (Company Records & Compliance)
description:

We are a small international group building an online platform over the next 18 months. The first company in the group is a holding company being formed in St. Vincent and the Grenadines; others will follow as the project grows. We need someone organised and trustworthy in the Philippines to look after the group’s corporate paperwork and act as an officer of record where a group company needs one.



What you would do



• Keep the group’s corporate records in order: registers, resolutions, certificates, agreements

• Liaise with the companies’ registered agents, notaries and, when needed, banks

• Arrange notarisation and courier of documents; maintain the group’s KYC files

• Track annual renewals and filing deadlines

• Prepare and sign resolutions and other corporate documents on the owner’s written instruction

• Serve as the appointed manager (officer of record) of group companies where required, under a written agreement that sets out your duties, the owner’s indemnity for the company’s obligations, and your right to resign at any time

• Light general admin: scheduling, document formatting, correspondence



What you need



• Based in the Philippines with no plans to move abroad in the next year

• A valid Philippine passport and proof of address in your own name (utility or internet bill, or driver’s licence); registered agents must verify the identity of every officer, the same way a bank does

• Reliable, organised and comfortable with legal and administrative paperwork

• Good written English; Google Docs or Word

• Background in administration, legal support, accounting or banking is a plus, not a must



What you get



• Monthly pay, long-term, with the role growing as the group does

• Any notary or courier costs reimbursed

• Clear written agreements for anything you sign or are appointed to

• We never ask you to pay anything



To apply, send a short note about yourself and any relevant experience.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (AI B-ROLL AND CHARACTERS)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance

We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.

Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.

You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder (A-Players Only)
description:
Company: ARSA (Auto Repair Sales Accelerator) / NGD Media 



Reports to: Theo Singh, Founder - Remote (must work UK business hours) 

Pay: [$1200 - $2200+ based on experience] + performance bonus



READ THIS FIRST

This is not an easy job. It is not a “nice little admin role”, and it is not for everyone.

You will work directly with the founder of a fast-moving marketing agency that runs Meta and Google ads and CRM systems for 80+ businesses across the UK and US. Things move quickly, priorities change daily and you’ll be juggling a lot at once.



If you want a calm 9–5 with clear instructions for every task, please don’t apply. WE MEAN THAT.



You will be expected to be responsive 24/7.

If you’re the person who gets handed something you’ve never done before and says “leave it with me”, and then actually gets it done, keep reading.



What you’ll actually be doing

1. Owning Theo’s WhatsApp inbox - Manage a busy WhatsApp inbox: clients, team, partners, leads and suppliers - Reply on Theo’s behalf, in his voice, to anything you can handle yourself - Triage the rest: what needs Theo today, what can wait, what goes to someone else - Make sure nothing gets missed, forgotten or left on “read” - Give Theo a short daily summary or call: what’s done, what’s waiting on him, what’s on fire



2. Delegating and chasing the team - Turn Theo’s voice notes and quick messages into clear tasks for the right person (ops, client success, sales, creative) - Follow up until tasks are done. Chasing is part of the job, not an extra - Spot when something is stuck and fix it before Theo has to ask



3. Anything and everything else - Calendar and diary management, booking and rescheduling calls - Research: competitors, prospects, suppliers, tools, new markets - Preparing docs, briefs, slides, spreadsheets and reports - Keeping track of projects and side ventures so nothing slips - Using AI tools to get things done faster - Personal and business admin as it comes up - Whatever else lands on your desk. It will be varied, and some of it you’ll have never done before



Who we’re looking for:

Must-haves - Perfect written and spoken English. You’ll be speaking for Theo to clients and partners. Typos and clumsy wording are not OK - A genuine “can do” attitude. “I don’t know how” is never the end of the sentence. It’s “I don’t know how yet, I’ll figure it out” - Resourceful. You Google it, YouTube it, ask AI, test it and come back with it done, not with questions you could have answered yourself - Extremely organised. You can juggle 30 open loops and still know exactly where each one is

Fast and responsive. Quick replies are a must. This role runs on speed - Proactive. You don’t wait to be told. You see what needs doing and do it - Discreet. You’ll see sensitive client, financial and personal information - Owns mistakes. When something goes wrong you say so straight away, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again



Strongly preferred - Experience working in or with a marketing agency (paid ads, CRM, client accounts) - Previous EA / PA / operations / project-management experience supporting a founder or exec - Comfortable with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp Business, GoHighLevel, ClickUp/Notion and ChatGPT or similar AI tools



What A-player looks like here:

Theo gives you a vague task at 10am. By the afternoon it’s done, and you’ve flagged two things he didn’t think of

Theo doesn’t have to remember anything, because you already have

The team know that when you ask for something, you’ll follow up

Clients get faster and better replies than they did before you arrived



After 90 days, Theo has hours back every week and wonders how he managed without you



Who this is NOT for

People who need step-by-step instructions for everything

People who say “that’s not my job”

People who get flustered when priorities change mid-day

People who need to be chased

People who say i haven’t done that before



What you get

Work directly with a founder and learn how a growing agency really runs, from sales and ads to operations and client success

A huge variety of work. You won’t be bored



Room to grow into an Operations / Chief of Staff role if you crush it



Fully remote

How to apply

We get a lot of applications, so here’s how we spot the people who read properly and follow instructions:



Submit a loom video explaining why you are the best fit FOR THIS SPECIFIC ROLE

Include your CV or LinkedIn



Applications that don’t follow these steps won’t be reviewed.

title: Real Estate Lead Generation & Operations VA - GHL & Propstream Expert
description:
REAL ESTATE LEAD GENERATION & OPERATIONS VA

We are looking for a resourceful and experienced Virtual Assistant to join our growing real estate and short-term rental business.



This is NOT a basic data-entry VA role.



You should be comfortable researching properties, working with real estate leads, cold calling prospects, managing a CRM, and using AI tools to work efficiently.





MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

Please apply ONLY if you have:

- PropStream — 3+ years experience

- GoHighLevel (GHL) — 3+ years experience

- Cold Calling / Outbound Prospecting — 3+ years experience

- ChatGPT — 1–2+ years experience

- Claude experience is a plus



We will train you on our processes, but we are not looking to train someone from scratch on these tools.





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

- Airbnb / VRBO

- Zillow / Redfin / 

- Skip tracing

- Real estate lead generation

- Google Sheets

- Google Maps

- Google Reverse Image Search

- Public property records

- CRM management

- Short-term rentals

- Real estate investing or property management



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You may be responsible for:

- Researching properties and owners using PropStream

- Skip tracing and verifying contact information

- Managing leads and follow-ups in GoHighLevel

- Cold calling property owners and prospective clients

- Updating CRM notes, tasks, and pipeline stages

- Researching Airbnb and VRBO listings

- Using Zillow, Redfin, Google Maps, county records, and other sources

- Organizing research in Google Sheets

- Using ChatGPT or Claude for research, analysis, troubleshooting, and productivity

- Helping improve our lead-generation processes



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT

1. Detective Work

Sometimes one website will not give you the answer.



You may need to search several sources, gather small pieces of information, and connect the dots to form the complete picture.



2. Organized

After doing all that research, we do not want the information to get lost.



Your work should be organized, documented, and easy to find later.



Do the work once and preserve it properly.



3. Ownership

Mistakes happen.



Own it. Fix it. Learn from it. Move on. Do not repeat it.



We value accountability, not excuses.



4. Independent & Resourceful

We will give you direction, but we do not want to explain every single step.



Try another search. Check another source. Use AI. Think through the problem.



Have the determination to finish the task at hand.



5. Sense of Urgency

If something can reasonably be finished today, there is no reason to push it to tomorrow.



Work efficiently, maintain accuracy, and keep things moving.



COLD CALLING

You must be comfortable speaking with property owners and prospects.



You should be able to:

- Speak clear English

- Have natural conversations

- Ask follow-up questions

- Handle basic objections

- Take accurate notes

- Update GHL correctly

- Follow up with leads when appropriate





++ IMPORTANT - READ BEFORE APPLYING ++

We want to learn about you, NOT how well AI can write your resume for you.



If you use AI to write or rewrite your resume, cover letter, or application response, you will NOT be considered.



Please apply using your own words.



Your English does not have to be perfect.



We would rather see your natural communication style and understand how you think.



This is NOT an anti-AI rule. We actively use ChatGPT and Claude in our business for automation.



We simply want to evaluate the real person behind the application first.





GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

This position can grow into more responsibility for the right person, including:

- Full time position

- Creating and improving SOPs

- Training other VAs

- Reviewing research

- Managing lead-generation workflows

- Managing team members

- Taking greater ownership of operations



Leadership ability is highly valued.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

Ask yourself:

Can I figure things out?

Am I organized?

Do I take ownership of mistakes?

Can I work independently?

Do I have a strong sense of urgency?



If yes — and you meet the experience requirements above — we would like to hear from you.

Dig until you find it.

Organize it so we do not lose it.

Own your work.

Figure things out.

Keep things moving.

title: Student Onboarding Specialist
description:
Student Onboarding Specialist – School of Barbers



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Business Hours



About School of Barbers



School of Barbers is a Melbourne-based barber school offering hands-on, face-to-face training, including our flagship 6 Week Barber Academy. Our courses are led by award-winning master barbers and combine practical training, mentorship and certification to get students shop-ready.



We are growing fast. More students are enrolling every month, and we need someone to make sure every one of them has an excellent experience from the moment they say “yes.”



About the Role



We’re looking for a Student Onboarding Specialist to own the journey between enrollment and a student’s first day in the chair.



When a student enrolls, they are excited, sometimes nervous, and usually full of questions. Your job is to turn that excitement into a confident, prepared student who shows up on day one ready to learn.



You will be the first real point of contact a new student has with our school after they enrol. The way you communicate will shape how they feel about us.



The right person is warm, disciplined, organised and reliable. They follow up without being asked, and they make sure no student slips through the cracks.



⸻



Key Responsibilities:



Welcome new students promptly by phone, SMS,
 or WhatsApp

Collect and check enrolment documents, and follow up anything missing

Confirm payments and politely follow up outstanding instalments

Send course schedules, location details, kit lists and reminders

Confirm attendance before each intake and chase students who go quiet

Answer student questions and escalate anything you can’t resolve

Coordinate handovers between the sales team and trainers

Keep the CRM and onboarding trackers accurate and up to date

Collect feedback, testimonials and Google reviews

Send management regular reports on intake readiness, outstanding items and no-shows



⸻



What We’re Looking For:



Excellent spoken and written English

Warm, friendly and confident on the phone

Highly organised and detail-oriented

Proactive, reliable and able to work independently

Comfortable following people up politely but firmly

Experience in customer service, student support, admissions or client onboarding (Australian clients or the education sector is a bonus)

Confident with Google Workspace, CRMs, Slack and similar tools, and quick to learn new software



⸻



What Success Looks Like:



Every student is contacted quickly after enrolling.

Files and payments are complete before courses start.

Students arrive on day one prepared and confident.

No-shows and drop-outs go down.

Positive reviews keep growing.



⸻



Working Hours & Salary



Full-time remote in the Philippines, with hours that substantially overlap Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT). You’ll need reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a headset.



₱45,000 – ₱55,000 PHP per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses and room to grow into Team Lead and Student Experience Manager roles.



⸻



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction and your relevant experience

An example of a time you went above and beyond for a customer

The software you’re confident using

Your expected monthly salary (PHP) and start date

A 2–3 mins video introduction



Important: Begin your application with the phrase “Ready to Onboard”. Applications without it will not be considered.

We receive a large number of applications, and attention to detail is essential in this role. Missing one small detail can mean a student isn’t ready on day one.

title: Customer Support Team Lead & Operations Manager (E-commerce / Shopify)
description:
**This is NOT a role for someone who simply follows SOPs or waits for instructions.**



We’re looking for a TEAM LEAD who can tell us what needs to be improved, rather than waiting for us to tell them what to do. You should be someone who takes initiative, thinks logically, proactively identifies problems, and suggests practical ways to improve our operations.



Position: Customer Support Lead & Operations Manager 

Salary: $1,400-$1,700 depending on the experience

Work Hours (Philippines time): Monday- Friday, 8.00am - 5.00pm (1 hour lunch break)

Support experience (Shopify, Ticket tools) : 3+ years

Leadership Experience: 2+ years people leadership



About Us

We’re a growing international e-commerce brand. Looking for an experienced Customer Support Lead & Operations Manager who can independently lead our customer support team, improve our workflows, and coordinate with our fulfillment warehouse (3PL) and factory.



Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Support Team Management

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of our small customer support team (1-2 people).

* Have strong hands-on experience with Shopify, ticketing systems, chargebacks, disputes, returns, refunds, and public review platforms such as Trustpilot.

* Guide team members in handling complicated customer cases outside of SOP and finding fair solutions that balance customer satisfaction with company profitability.

* Monitor individual support team performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide reports.

* Evaluate team workload and determine whether additional staff are needed as the business grows, or whether existing workflows can be optimized first.

* Ensure customer complaints on social media, Trustpilot, and public groups are handled professionally to protect our brand reputation.



2. Workflow Optimization & SOP Development

* Review our existing customer support processes and proactively identify inefficiencies.

* Improve existing SOPs and create new ones when situations arise that aren't covered by current procedures.

* Recommend better Shopify apps, customer support tools, and AI solutions to reduce repetitive manual work.

* Identify recurring customer issues and develop long-term solutions rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems.

* Take ownership of operational improvements instead of waiting for management to identify what needs to change.



3. Factory & 3PL Coordination

* Act as the main point of contact between the customer support team, fulfillment warehouse (3PL), and factory to resolve customer-related issues. For example, identify recurring shipping or product quality problems through customer feedback, coordinate with the relevant teams to implement improvements, and prevent the same issues from happening again.

* Communicate directly with the 3PL to investigate delivery issues, improve fulfillment processes, and resolve warehouse concerns.

* Communicate directly with the factory regarding product defects, quality improvements and production timeline to help prevent stock delays.

* Use actual customer complaints and support data to help make informed decisions about product inspections and acceptable quality standards.

* Ensure issues are followed through until resolved, rather than simply passing messages between departments.



What We're Looking For:

* Proven experience in a senior customer support or customer experience management role in e-commerce business.

* Strong knowledge of Shopify, customer support ticketing systems, payment disputes, chargebacks, returns, and refunds.

* Experience managing remote customer support teams and evaluating employee performance.

* Excellent logical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Ability to balance customer satisfaction with business profitability.

* Experience improving SOPs, implementing automation, and using AI tools to improve productivity.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Comfortable communicating with fulfillment partners, suppliers, and factories.

* Highly organized, proactive, accountable, and able to work independently without constant supervision.



Who This Role Is NOT For

This position may not be the right fit if you:

* Prefer following instructions rather than making independent decisions.

* Only have experience answering customer tickets without managing or improving operations.

* Wait for problems to happen instead of identifying ways to prevent them.

* Escalate every difficult situation to the business owner without first evaluating possible solutions.

* Are looking for a temporary job rather than a long-term career.



What We Offer

* Salary Growth: Opportunities for salary increases as the company grow.

* Stable Long-Term Career: We offer a stable, full-time position with a growing international brand.

* Performance Bonuses: Bonuses based on your performance, contributions, and the company's growth.

* Career Growth: Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities and advance into a more senior leadership position.

* Independence & Ownership: You'll have the authority to make decisions, implement improvements, and lead your team without constant micromanagement.

* Supportive Work Environment: We value initiative, logical thinking, open communication, and continuous improvement.



What Success Looks Like:

Our goal is to have someone who can take full ownership of the customer experience department.

We expect you to identify issues, evaluate possible solutions, make informed decisions within your authority, and keep management updated on results.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone who can make our operations more efficient, improve customer satisfaction, reduce unnecessary costs, and allow the business owner to focus on growing the brand instead of managing daily support issues.



How to Apply

Please answer the following questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have managing customer support teams for e-com brands? Please name the companies/brands.

2. What did your day-to-day responsibilities involve? Please name the tools you used.

3. How many customer service agents have you managed?

4. Tell us about a workflow or SOP you improved in your previous role. What was the problem, what did you change, and what was the result?

5. Have you worked directly with fulfillment warehouses (3PLs) or factories to resolve customer-related issues, what did you do?

6. What AI tools or automation have you implemented to improve customer support efficiency?

7. You noticed a 1-star review on our TrustPilot, what would you do?

8. If customer support workload increased by 50%, how would you d
 whether to hire another employee or optimize the current team's workflow?

Schedule appointments while ensuring that the patient's "important person" (IP), such as a significant other or key individual in their life, is involved. mbers and office staff to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Foster a positive and professional environment for everyone involved.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
Digital Marketing Coordinator: run a Multiple episode-a-week podcast operation (no editing, full-time, long-term)



Run a multiple-episode-a-week podcast operation. No editing. Fully remote.



Full-time, long-term | Remote | USD $12 to $16 per hour depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits | Mon to Fri, 9am to 5pm Adelaide time



You've run production before. You know what it looks like when it's working, and you know exactly how it unravels when nobody is thinking at least 4 weeks ahead.



Maybe you're the one quietly holding it together right now, without the title or the authority to fix what's broken. Maybe you've been asked to produce, book, edit and post all at once, and the part you're actually good at, running the operation, keeps getting squeezed out. Or you're inside a big network where the plan changes daily and "as directed" is in your job description.



This is a different shape of job.



Your mission: keep every show at least four weeks ahead, every week.

Multiple episodes a week across multiple shows. Recordings booked months out. Editors who know what they're cutting. Clients who know what's coming. Problems found long before they become urgent.



You won't edit anything. You'll run the operation that keeps 3 to 5 editors and 2 virtual assistants fed, on time and out of the Director's inbox.





WHO YOU'D BE JOINING

Pizza & Property is an Australian property investment podcast and YouTube channel, publishing since 2019, more than 1,000 episodes, and rated 4.8 stars by listeners across Apple Podcasts and Spotify. We've grown into live panel events, an investor education course, and a production studio "P&P Studios" in the Adelaide CBD that now produces multiple custom podcasts for clients alongside our own show. The studio producing custom podcast and YouTube channels is where we're now growing!



The studio runs on systems, not heroics: an Airtable pipeline that tracks every episode from "sold" to "published", Slack automations that help manage workflow with editors, Canva shoot packs for every recording, and an SOP library we're building out. Our production team is already remote. You'd be stepping into a running machine, and once you've learned it, you'd have licence to make it better!



You'll report directly to the founder and Director, Todd Sloan. We're a small, remote, founder-led team of people who love what they do and care about doing it well. Short daily calls, headlines not waffle. Nobody's looking over your shoulder, but nobody's hiding either: if a show slips, everyone knows, and we fix it together.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Keeping production ahead. Plan air dates, run the content calendar across multiple shows and protect the four-week buffer.

• Booking every recording. Guests and clients, including interstate clients who fly in quarterly to record three months of episodes in one visit.

• Running the pipeline. Assign episodes to editors and track each one through Airtable from recording to publish-ready.

• Keeping clients organised. Track packages and inclusions, flag renewals two months out, and coordinate agreements and approvals with the Director.

• Setting up every shoot. Shoot packs, ideation sessions, content calls, shoot days, intro recordings, and titles and thumbnails scheduled on time.

• Leading the team. Daily point of contact for 3 to 5 editors and 2 VAs. 

• Keeping the Director informed, not involved. Manage the production and bookings inbox, and run one short daily call: headlines, decisions needed, your recommendation.





WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

• Real ownership. The whole operation, not a slice of it.

• No editing. Ever. That's what our amazing editors are for.

• A direct line to the founder. One daily call, no layers in between.

• Long-term and full-time, with 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits.

• Remote, with a fixed rhythm: 9 to 5 Adelaide time, Monday to Friday.

• Systems already built. You inherit a machine, then improve it.

• A front-row seat in the Australian property industry: the guests, panels and clients you'll be booking are the people investors listen to.





YOU MIGHT BE



• An agency production coordinator who has run the schedules for several clients' shows at once but never been handed the authority to own the operation.

• A producer who has worked out that the part you love is the operation, not the edit.

• An operations person from a creator or media business who wants a smaller team and a bigger remit.

• Someone who already keeps multiple calendars in their head and would rather keep them in Airtable.





WHO SHOULDN'T APPLY



• You want to edit. There's no editing in this role.

• You need the day's priorities handed to you each morning.

• You bring problems without a recommended fix.

• You treat "four weeks ahead" as a stretch goal rather than the floor.

• You can't commit to 9 to 5 Adelaide time, Monday to Friday, every week.

• You've only ever run one show. This role is multiple shows and five episodes a week from day one.





WHAT YOU'LL NEED



This isn't an entry-level production role. You'll be taking responsibility for a live pipeline across three shows from day one, so hands-on agency experience running more than one show at a time is essential.



• Agency or studio experience managing multiple podcasts or YouTube channels at the same time, from recording through to publication. This one is non-negotiable.

• Experience coordinating schedules, bookings, people and deadlines.

• The ability to plan a content calendar with an eye for guest and topic variety.

• Experience working directly with a founder, director or senior executive.

• Clear, confident spoken and written English.

• Confidence with Gmail, Airtable, Slack, Canva and Dropbox. 
 is a bonus; we're moving our file management across to it.

• A reliable internet connection and a quiet space to work from.





HOW WE'LL SET YOU UP

You'll spend your first one to two months shadowing the person who runs this now, learning the process, the team, the clients and the systems. From there you take ownership progressively, and you'll have the room to refine the processes you've inherited. You'll work directly with the Director, with a daily rhythm that keeps priorities and decisions aligned.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Imagine reaching the end of the week knowing every show is four weeks ahead. Recordings are booked. Editors know what they're working on. Clients are organised. Problems were resolved before they became emergencies. And the Director knows what's happening without having to manage a single detail.



That's the difference you'll be making.





THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

• Position: Digital Marketing Coordinator

• Location: Remote, with a reliable internet connection

• Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Adelaide time

• Remuneration: USD 12 to 16 per hour depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits





HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter. Just four things:



1. Three bullet points, one line each, on why you're the right person for this role.

2. Links to the podcasts or YouTube channels you've managed, with a line on your role in each and which of them you ran at the same time.

3. A 60 to 90 second video or voice note (phone quality is fine, unlisted link is fine) answering: tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping a production schedule weeks ahead. How did you run it, and what happened? No script. We want to hear you, not read a perfect paragraph.

4. Your favourite movie. We're curious.



Applications close 28 October 2026. We'll reply to everyone who completes all four steps. References will be requested from shortlisted candidates.





If you're ready to run the operation that keeps great content moving, we'd love to hear from you.
