title: Ecommerce Video Editor for Meta Ads — Long-Term
description:
I run a growing ecommerce brand and am looking for a skilled video editor to produce engaging
 and Instagram video ads consistently.

I currently handle the creative work myself and want someone who can take ownership of video editing, understand the products, and become a reliable part of the business.



What you’ll be doing

• Create product video ads using UGC footage, product demonstrations, B-roll, voiceovers, and images.

• Turn creative briefs into engaging ads with strong hooks, clear storytelling, and a clear call to action.

• Use basic AI tools for additional clips, images, or voiceovers when needed.

• Create variations by testing different openings, footage, pacing, and messaging.

• Expected output: approximately 20–25 video ads per week, typically 30–60 seconds each. Scripts will be provided to you.

• Add clean captions, sound effects, music, and natural transitions.

• Export ads in formats including 9:16 and 4:5.

• Revise work based on feedback and use performance insights to improve future edits.

• Organise footage, project files, and finished exports. 

• Suggest creative improvements and fresh ideas.

The main focus of this role is video ad production for Meta.



I will provide the scripts, marketing angles, product information, and creative direction. You will source suitable footage, use AI tools when need, and turn the brief into a finished video ad.

• Find relevant product demonstrations, UGC-style clips, lifestyle footage, and B-roll from supplier assets, stock libraries, and other platforms, checking permission for advertising use.

• Expected output: approximately 20–25 video ads per week, typically 30–60 seconds each. We will agree on the number of new edits, hook variations, and format exports before starting.



Who I’m looking for

• Experience editing ecommerce or direct-response video ads for
 and Instagram.

• A portfolio showing relevant product ads—not only general reels or cinematic videos.

• An understanding of how to capture attention in the first few seconds and maintain interest.

• Strong English comprehension, especially for captions, scripts, and messaging.

• Good judgment when selecting visuals that match the script and accurately show the product.

• Reliable communication, attention to detail, and consistent delivery.

• Someone who can follow a brief, contribute ideas, and apply feedback independently.

You can use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or another professional editing workflow. The quality of your work matters more than the software.

Experience with AI video and voiceover tools, or static image ads is a bonus.

Working arrangement

• Remote ongoing role.

• Long-term opportunity, with bonuses for meeting agreed performance expectations and delivering consistent, high-quality work.



• Working hours, weekly output, turnaround times, and compensation agreed before starting.

• Please include your expected rate in Australian dollar.



I value clear communication, dependable delivery, and thoughtful creative work. I’m looking for someone interested in building an ongoing working relationship.

How to apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction and your relevant ecommerce editing experience.

2. Links to three of your best ecommerce video ads. Explain exactly what you handled in each.

3. The editing software and AI tools you use.

4. Your expected monthly rate in Australian dollar, Weekly or monthly payments, depending on the arrangement agreed and your earliest start date.

5. Your usual turnaround time for a 30–60-second ad when the brief, script, and footage are supplied.

6. One example of how you would improve an ad’s opening hook.

Start your application with “ECOMMERCE EDITOR” so I know you’ve read the full post.

Shortlisted applicants will complete a small video creation and editing test to assess quality, speed, and ability to follow a brief.

title: Remote Fashion Image Labeling
description:
We're an AI fashion company building a large set of labeled clothing photos, and we're looking for detail-oriented people to help label them.



The work is labeling fashion photos: you look at product pictures and photos of people wearing the clothes, and answer short questions about each garment, choosing from a fixed set of answers. Each task comes with a clear guide and visual charts that show what every answer means, so no fashion background is required, though it is a plus. Accuracy matters more than speed. The tasks cover different types of clothing, and new tasks are added over time. The work is done online in a web-based labeling tool, and each task is short, so it's easy to fit into your own schedule.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this. 



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management



 The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can eventually own the entire backend with minimal supervision.

You should be able to look at the operation and immediately understand:

What is working? What is not working? Where are we losing money? What needs to be fixed? Who needs to handle it? And what needs to happen next?

You must be comfortable taking ownership, communicating with suppliers and team members, analyzing numbers, solving problems, and stepping into the details when necessary.

We are looking for an operator, not someone who simply delegates tasks.



Requirements

✅ Solid e-commerce/dropshipping experience

✅ Experience with overseas suppliers/fulfillment

✅ Experience handling refunds and cancellations

✅ Strong dispute/chargeback experience

✅ Understanding of COGS and profit margins

✅ Experience managing or working with phone support teams

✅ Strong operational and analytical skills

✅ Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

✅ Full-time availability

✅ Willingness to work longer hours when operationally necessary

✅ Willingness to learn both backend and frontend operations

✅ Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Optional:

✅ Experience with AI and outsourcing

✅ CLaude code Chatgpt Codex

title: Administrative Coordinator (Remote)
description:

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Administrative Coordinator with a strong project manager mindset to help manage administrative workflows, coordinate tasks, maintain organizational systems, and keep daily business operations running smoothly.



This role is ideal for someone who naturally thinks in terms of priorities, timelines, systems, and next steps. You will work closely with leadership and team members to coordinate priorities, maintain an effective task management system, monitor progress, follow up on outstanding responsibilities, and ensure important tasks are completed on time.



Key Responsibilities

Coordinate and monitor ongoing projects, tasks, and deadlines to ensure timely completion.

Build, maintain, and improve a centralized task management system that provides clear visibility into priorities, responsibilities, and progress.

Maintain project timelines, track deliverables, and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

Identify what needs attention next instead of waiting for leadership to assign every task.

Recognize gaps, bottlenecks, and recurring issues within existing workflows.

, and project management platforms.

Keep leadership informed of progress, concerns, and priorities.

Manage files, spreadsheets, calendars, and business information using Google Workspace.

Keep important information organized, accessible, and up to date.

Assist with administrative and operational tasks as needed to support business priorities.

Take ownership of assigned responsibilities from planning through completion.

Monitor progress and ensure important tasks do not fall through the cracks.

Identify opportunities to improve organization, efficiency, accountability, and team workflows.

Develop and document systems, procedures, and checklists that improve productivity.

Investigate recurring problems and recommend practical solutions.

Look for ways to make the team's work more organized and efficient rather than simply maintaining existing processes.



Qualifications

Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

A natural project manager mindset, with the ability to think ahead, prioritize, and coordinate multiple moving parts.

Experience creating, implementing, or improving task management systems and workflows.

Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Calendar.

Comfortable using Slack, WhatsApp,
, and collaboration tools.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve problems without constant supervision.

Strong accountability and follow-through.

Ability to recognize gaps, anticipate needs, and recommend process improvements.



Nice to Have:

Experience supporting a business owner, leadership team, or growing business.

Experience implementing project management systems or improving operational workflows.



Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who is:

Detail-Oriented: Notices missing information, overlooked tasks, and potential issues.

Proactive: Anticipates what needs to happen next instead of waiting for instructions.

title: Full-Time AI Video Editor (Higgsfield), US Ad Brand, 7+ Videos a Week
description:
Job type: Full-time · Salary: $1500 per month (we are willing to pay more for top talents) · Skills: Video Editing, AI Video Generation, Higgsfield, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut



READ THIS FIRST

This is a full-time, exclusive position. You cannot have another job, another client or freelance work on the side. We check, and we end the contract if we find out.

If you do not have extensive, hands-on experience generating AND editing AI video into finished videos of 2 minutes or longer, do not apply. Applications without examples that meet the criteria below will not be answered.



WHO WE ARE

Flow Pouch is a fast-growing US direct-to-consumer brand. We make functional mushroom pouches, a nicotine-free alternative to nicotine pouches, and we sell through paid video ads. Our editors make the ads that run the business. Expectations are very high and the KPIs are not negotiable.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Produce at least 7 fully edited videos a week, 1 to 5 minutes long, from written briefs. Generations are done in Higgsfield; editing is in the software of your choice (Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut, anything you are fast in). You work on a fixed weekly schedule inside our brief and feedback system with a strategist and the editing lead.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Extensive, provable experience generating AI video (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway or similar) and editing it into finished 2+ minute videos. You will send examples of exactly this. Short clips, reels or motion graphics showreels do not count.

Speed. A finished video in a day, not in two.

Fluent written English, a reliable connection and a machine that handles long-form editing.

Full-time availability on a schedule aligned to our team.



HOW WE HIRE

description:

.

- Available 4 hours per day, 7 days a week (28 hours/week). Your hours are flexible as long as your daily videos are delivered.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with organic dropshipping or e-commerce content

- Experience using Claude or ChatGPT for prompting



PAY & TERMS

- $3–4 per hour, depending on your skills and test results

- Long-term position with a growing team

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Title: Supply Chain Manager – Home Decor E-commerce (Part-time, growing to Full-time)

About us By Meredith is a premium home decor brand selling online to customers in the UK, USA and Australia. We work with international fulfilment partners and are building our own backend team. You'll be one of our first two team members, so you'll help shape how we work.

The role You make sure every order is processed and shipped on time, with healthy margins, and that problems are solved before the customer notices. You start at 4 hours per day, with the clear intention to grow into a full-time role as volume increases.

What you'll do

• Check all new orders every day and enter purchase prices in our dashboard to monitor margins (minimum 60%).

• Monitor orders that aren't fulfilled after 48 hours or show no tracking movement for 7 days, and resolve them with our fulfilment agents.

• Communicate daily and directly with our fulfilment agents in China via Slack, in English.

• Find an alternative supplier quote when an item can't be delivered, check the margin, and draft unavailable products in Shopify.

• Handle lost, damaged and wrong-item claims with suppliers and couriers, and claim refunds for returned parcels.

• Flag products with high refund rates or price increases that hurt margins.

• Post a short daily update and report on your KPIs: processing time max 5 days, delivery time max 14 days, orders with an issue max 5%.

• Work closely with our Customer Service & Dispute Specialist.

Must-haves

• At least 3 years of experience in supply chain or order management for e-commerce / dropshipping.

• Proven experience in the home decor niche (furniture, decor, homeware).

• Experience working with Chinese suppliers or fulfilment agents.

• Hands-on experience with all the tools we use: Shopify, Slack, ParcelPanel (or similar tracking apps), Gorgias and Whop.

• Strong written English.

• Comfortable with numbers: margins, purchase prices, shipping costs.

• Structured and independent: you spot problems early and come with a solution, not just the problem.

• Reliable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

• Experience with order and margin dashboards or spreadsheets.

• Experience with shipments to the UK, USA and Australia.

Schedule and pay

• 4 hours per day, Monday to Saturday (24 hours per week), in the morning UK time.

• Growth to full-time as volume increases.

• Pay: USD 2.75 per hour (around USD 285 per month), with a raise when moving to full-time.

How to apply To show you've read this post, start your application with the words "Home Decor Supply". Then tell us in a few sentences:

1. Your experience in the home decor niche, and with which stores or brands.

2. How you would handle an order that hasn't shipped after 5 days while the supplier doesn't reply.

3. Which of our tools you've worked with, and for how long.

Shortlisted candidates do a short paid test task and an interview. Applications without the opening words won't be considered.

s in Gorgias within 24 hours, including weekends, in a formal and premium tone (British English).

Nice to have

• Experience with customers in the UK, USA and Australia.

Schedule and pay

title: Sales
description:
Sales Caller for US Company – $4/hr + Big Commissions – Excellent English Required



Remote | Philippines Preferred | Hourly + Commission | Long-Term Opportunity



Hello, and thanks for stopping by!



We're a small, friendly marketing company based in Boise, Idaho, USA. We run online ads that connect homeowners who need tree work with local tree companies. Each company gets calls exclusively in its own area, and they get to try us free for 14 days before d
 anything.



We're growing, and we're looking for a warm, confident caller to grow with us long-term.



The one thing we care about most is spoken English. You'll be chatting with American business owners, so we're looking for someone who speaks English fluently and naturally, and who's comfortable with a real conversation — questions, surprises, and all. If you've spoken with US customers before, that's a big plus.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



* Call US tree company owners from a list we provide — no hunting for your own leads.

* Introduce our free 14-day trial using a simple script we'll give you.

* Have friendly, natural conversations and answer basic questions.

* If an owner asks about price, it's $2,250 per month after the trial, and there's no obligation to continue.

* Help interested owners complete our short sign-up form.

* Follow up with owners who asked for a callback.

* Keep simple notes on your calls in HubSpot (we'll show you how).



We provide the calling list, the script, the CRM, and a US phone number for your calls.



WHAT YOU'LL EARN



$4 USD per hour (up to 20 hours per week), plus commissions — and the commissions are where it gets good:



* $50 when a company signs up and starts its free 14-day trial.

* $500 when the company makes its first monthly payment.

* $100 bonus when the company makes its third monthly payment.



That's $650 for every client who signs up and stays with us. There's no cap on commissions.



We pay every Friday through Wise. Each sign-up is verified before commissions are paid — it's just how we keep things fair for everyone.



HOURS & FLEXIBILITY



Work from home and plan your own schedule. There are no fixed daily hours and no call quotas — we just ask that calls happen during reasonable US business hours, and that follow-ups don't get forgotten. We'd love to find someone who enjoys this kind of work and wants to be part of the team for the long haul.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...



* Speak English fluently, clearly, and naturally — this matters more to us than anything else.

* Enjoy talking with people and sound friendly and confident on the phone.

* Have called US businesses or customers before (preferred, but not required).

* Are honest and dependable, and would never promise a business owner results we can't guarantee.

* Have reliable internet, a quiet place to call from, and a good headset.



HOW TO APPLY



Applying takes about two minutes — just two steps:



1. Start your application with the words TREE CALLS (this just tells us you read the post).



2. Tell us a little about your experience and availability — any experience calling US businesses, when you're available during US business hours, and why this sounds like a good fit for you.



That's all for now. If we like your application, we'll message you and ask for a short video introducing yourself (30 to 60 seconds — just your name and a bit about your experience, nice and relaxed). You can share it as an unlisted YouTube link or a Google Drive link set to "Anyone with the link." Since spoken English is the heart of this job, the video is how we get to hear it before a quick interview.



Thanks so much for your time — we look forward to meeting you!

title: AI Video Creator & Editor — Higgsfield AI
description:
# AI Video Creator & Editor — Higgsfield AI



**Company:** VanishedOC  

**Position:** Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term  

**Starting Pay:** $2/hour (40 hours/week)  

**BONUSES + PERMANENT PAY RAISES FOR VIRAL VIDEOS!**



### About Us



VanishedOC is an automotive brand looking for a highly creative and experienced AI video creator/editor to produce viral-style content for TikTok and Instagram.



We're looking for someone who can independently come up with great video ideas, generate realistic footage using Higgsfield, and turn those ideas into fully edited, engaging videos.



**We're NOT looking for someone who just knows how to generate AI videos. We want someone who understands what makes videos go viral and has the creativity to consistently come up with great concepts.**



### 💰 PAY & VIRAL VIDEO BONUSES — IMPORTANT!



We want to reward people who produce results, not just people who complete tasks.



Your starting pay is **$2/hour for 40 hours per week**, but that's only the beginning.



Here's how you can earn more:



- **30,000+ Views:** Earn a performance bonus when your video reaches 30K authentic, organic views from our target audience.

- **100,000+ Views:** Earn an additional bonus AND receive a **permanent $0.25/hour raise**.

- **Every Additional Viral Video:** Each new qualifying video that reaches 100K+ views earns another bonus and another permanent $0.25/hour raise.

- **No fixed cap on performance-based raises:** The more qualifying viral videos you create, the higher your hourly rate can grow.



For example, if you consistently create videos that reach 100K+ views:



| Qualifying viral videos | New hourly rate |

|---|---|

| Starting rate | $2.00/hr |

| 4 videos | $3.00/hr |

| 8 videos | $4.00/hr |

| 12 videos | $5.00/hr |

| 20 videos | $7.00/hr |



**These raises are permanent, not one-time bonuses!**



If you're genuinely good at creating engaging content and consistently produce viral videos, you have the opportunity to earn significantly more than the starting rate.



All qualifying views must come from legitimate viewers within our target audience. Artificial or botted engagement does not qualify. Bonus amounts and verification terms will be confirmed before hiring.



**We're looking for someone who sees this as an opportunity to grow, not just another hourly job.**



### Responsibilities



- Produce **5 GOOD, fully finished videos per week**.

- Independently brainstorm original, engaging video concepts.

- Generate realistic, high-quality AI footage using Higgsfield.

- Create accurate starting frames to reduce wasted AI credits.

- Edit videos with music, sound effects, transitions, and strong pacing.

- Research trends, hooks, and successful viral content.

- Use our existing B-roll, AI footage, and product references when appropriate.

- Continuously experiment with new concepts and improve video performance.



### Requirements



- Previous experience with Higgsfield or similar AI video generation tools.

- Strong editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, etc.).

- Excellent creativity and understanding of viral short-form content.

- Ability to independently develop attention-grabbing video concepts.

- Experience generating realistic AI footage with consistent product details.

- Ability to optimize starting frames and use AI credits efficiently.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and willingness to improve.



**CREATIVITY IS OUR #1 PRIORITY.** We want someone who thinks outside the box, brings their own ideas, and genuinely puts effort into making great videos.



### What We Provide



- **9,000 Higgsfield credits per month**, fully covered by us.

- Existing AI footage, automotive B-roll, and product reference images.

- Training on our workflow, content style, and creative expectations.

- Ongoing feedback and guidance.

- Long-term opportunity with performance-based bonuses and permanent pay increases.



### 🎬 IMPORTANT — SAMPLE VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY



We receive a lot of applications, so instead of long cover letters, we want to see what you can actually create.



**Before applying, search VanishedOC on TikTok and Instagram** to understand our product and content style.



Then create **ONE original video** that you believe would perform well for our brand.



Your video must:

- Be 10–20 seconds long, vertical 9:16.

- Include realistic AI-generated footage.

- Be fully edited with music, sound effects, and engaging pacing.

- Have a strong hook that grabs attention immediately.

- Accurately represent our product using the provided reference images.

- Be ready to post on TikTok or Instagram.



You have full creative freedom. We want to see your own ideas and how well you execute them.



**Product Reference Images:** 

### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. **Your completed sample video (REQUIRED).**

2. Your portfolio or examples of previous work (optional).

3. A brief explanation of your video concept.

4. The AI tools you used.



**Applications without a sample video will not be considered.**



Please include the word **BLUE** in your application subject so we know you've read the instructions.



We'll review the videos and contact the strongest candidates for an interview.



If you're creative, ambitious, and confident in your ability to make viral content, we'd love to see what you can create!

title: Outreach & Admin VA (NDIS, Sales/BD)

Every referral you bring in earns you a bonus, paid weekly.

You won't be figuring things out on your own. We've built a proper outreach system: SOPs, call scripts,
 templates, gatekeeper playbooks and a Notion database tracking every contact. You'll be trained by our current VA, who built many of our referral relationships herself. If you've done sales or BD before, you'll hit the ground running and can put your energy into building relationships instead of working out the process.

- Outreach to Support Coordinators, plan managers and other referrers by phone and
, using our scripts, templates and Notion system

, SMS and phone, with warmth and professionalism

- General admin: chasing overdue invoices, inbox management, and whatever else comes up. There's no script for every scenario, so we need someone who uses their judgement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Sales, business development or outreach experience is preferred

- NDIS experience is strongly preferred. Knowing how Support Coordinators and referrals work is a big advantage.

- Confident on the phone and not put off by gatekeepers or follow-ups

PAY, HOURS AND GROWTH

2. Start your application with the words "OUTREACH VA" so we know you've read the full post.

3. Tell us briefly about your sales or BD experience, and any NDIS experience you have.

s using a structured cadence.

s to leads and support social media content as needed.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week, spread across 7 days.



- The bulk of your hours fall on weekdays.

- Hours are scheduled within a window of 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Your actual schedule within that window is set with the studio owner and may shift by season. It will always be discussed and agreed on in advance.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD (Paid)



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

title: Backend Manager
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this.



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management



The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can eventually own the entire backend with minimal supervision.

You should be able to look at the operation and immediately understand:

What is working? What is not working? Where are we losing money? What needs to be fixed? Who needs to handle it? And what needs to happen next?

You must be comfortable taking ownership, communicating with suppliers and team members, analyzing numbers, solving problems, and stepping into the details when necessary.

We are looking for an operator, not someone who simply delegates tasks.



Requirements

✅ Solid e-commerce/dropshipping experience

✅ Experience with overseas suppliers/fulfillment

✅ Experience handling refunds and cancellations

✅ Strong dispute/chargeback experience

✅ Understanding of COGS and profit margins

✅ Experience managing or working with phone support teams

✅ Strong operational and analytical skills

✅ Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

✅ Full-time availability

✅ Willingness to work longer hours when operationally necessary

✅ Willingness to learn both backend and frontend operations

✅ Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Optional:

✅ Experience with AI and outsourcing

✅ CLaude code Chatgpt Codex

 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

title: Sales Strategist
description:
Job Description: Sales Strategist 



Overview 

Root Pages is a growing digital marketing agency looking for a thoughtful, relationship-focused Sales Strategist who knows how to listen, understand a business, and build trust before trying to make a sale. 



We are not looking for an aggressive salesperson or someone focused only on hitting outreach numbers. We want someone who is genuinely curious about people, asks good questions, communicates clearly, and takes the time to understand what a potential client actually needs. 



This is a hands-on sales role with significant ownership. You will help us improve how we generate leads, communicate with prospects, conduct sales conversations, follow up, and build long-term client relationships. 



We are specifically looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long-term. As Root Pages grows, this position is intended to develop into a senior sales leadership role with increased compensation, responsibility, and influence over our sales strategy. 



This is a fully remote position intended for candidates based in the Philippines.



Key Responsibilities 

• Build relationships with prospective clients and take time to understand their businesses, challenges, goals, and priorities 

• Conduct consultative sales conversations focused on finding the right solution rather than simply closing a deal 

• Ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and make prospects feel heard and understood 

• Develop and improve outbound strategies across
, LinkedIn, referrals, SMS, and other channels 

• Research prospective clients before outreach so communication feels relevant and personal 

• Identify ideal customer profiles, target industries, and strong-fit opportunities 

• Create and improve outreach messages, follow-up sequences, sales scripts, and processes 

• Manage prospect conversations from initial outreach through qualification and closing 

• Follow up consistently without being overly aggressive or impersonal 

• Clearly communicate our services, recommendations, pricing, and expectations 

• Maintain accurate customer records, notes, follow-ups, and pipeline information

• Identify patterns in prospect feedback and share insights that can improve our services, positioning, and sales process 

• Collaborate directly with company leadership on sales strategy and growth 



What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role is not measured only by the number of messages sent or calls made. 



We are looking for someone who can consistently create strong sales opportunities while leaving prospects with a positive impression of Root Pages, whether or not they ultimately become a client. 



Strong performance includes: 

• Building trust quickly with prospective clients 

• Understanding what a prospect actually needs before recommending a solution 

• Maintaining organized and thoughtful follow-up 

• Generating qualified opportunities and new revenue 

• Improving response, conversion, and close rates over time 

• Developing repeatable sales processes that still feel personal 

• Building relationships that can lead to long-term clients, referrals, and repeat business 



The Person We Are Looking For 



The right person is someone who can read a conversation, adapt their communication style, recognize when to listen rather than sell, and make people feel comfortable discussing their business. 



You should be: 

• Warm, professional, and easy to communicate with 

• Naturally curious about people and businesses 

• A strong listener who asks thoughtful follow-up questions 

• Empathetic and able to understand different personalities and communication styles 

• Comfortable building relationships over time rather than forcing an immediate sale 

• Confident without being pushy 

• Organized and dependable with follow-up 

• Comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving 

• Able to take ownership without needing constant direction 

• Motivated by helping both the client and the company succeed 



Qualifications 

• Experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar client-facing role 

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills 

• Demonstrated ability to build rapport and maintain professional relationships 

• Comfortable with outbound prospecting and handling rejection professionally 

• Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups without losing the personal touch 

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools 

• Experience with digital marketing, websites, SEO, advertising, or service-based businesses is a strong advantage 



Compensation 



Base Pay: 

PHP 420–PHP 630 per hour 



Full-time, 40 hours per week. Starting rate will depend on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated capability.



High performers will have the opportunity to significantly increase their total compensation as their pipeline and sales volume grow. 



As the company expands, this role is expected to develop into a senior sales leadership position with additional compensation, authority, and responsibility. 



Work Arrangement 

• Full-time remote position 

• Long-term position 



Why Join Root Pages? 

We Value You & Your Time 



We believe people do their best work when they feel respected, supported, and trusted. We want to build a company where people can grow professionally without sacrificing their personal well-being. 



Work-life balance is encouraged and protected. 



Paid Time Off & Holidays 

• 12 Paid Philippine Holidays 

• 1 Paid Company Holiday 

• 11 Flexible Paid Vacation Days, accrued over time 

• 7 Paid Sick Days, accrued over time 



Flexible Scheduling 

Life requires flexibility. We accommodate reasonable schedule adjustments whenever possible. With advance notice and manager approval, we work together to support personal responsibilities while maintaining strong team performance. 



Weathering Storms Together 

During major storms, natural disasters, and extreme weather events, we provide additional flexibility and support. Your safety and the well-being of your family come first. 



Growth Opportunity 

We are building for the long term and want this person to grow with us. 



A successful Sales Strategist will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of our sales department, help shape future sales processes, mentor future team members, and advance into a senior sales leadership role as Root Pages grows. 



How to Apply 



Please include: 

• Your resume 

• A short paragraph explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role 

• An example of a time when listening carefully to a customer or client changed how you approached a situation 

• An example of how you built or maintained a strong professional relationship 

• Your expected hourly rate in PHP 



We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate how they communicate with people, not just their sales numbers.

**Company:** Charly Surveying Services  

**Location:** Poblacion, Alcantara, Cebu, Philippines  

**Work Arrangement:** Office-Based or Remote / Work-from-Home  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  

**Application
:** 



## About the Role



Charly Surveying Services is looking for a skilled and motivated **Full Stack Software Developer specializing in .NET, Android, and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML)** to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and RESTful APIs, along with front-end development skills using React.js. Candidates should also have experience developing native Android applications using Java and practical knowledge of AI/ML technologies.



You will play an important role in designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable software solutions while integrating intelligent features into web and mobile applications.



**We offer both office-based and remote work arrangements.** Office-based employees will work at our office in Poblacion, Alcantara, Cebu, while remote applicants may work from home, subject to company requirements and approval.



## Key Responsibilities



### Backend Development

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain applications using .NET Framework and .NET Core.

- Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.

- Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases, including stored procedures, views, tables, indexing, and performance tuning.

### Frontend Development

- Develop and enhance user-facing features using React.js.

### Android Development

- Design, develop, test, and maintain native Android applications using Java.

### AI and Machine Learning

- Develop AI-powered features such as chatbots, recommendations, predictive analytics, computer vision, and natural language processing.

- Collect, clean, and prepare datasets for model training and evaluation.

- Evaluate and monitor model performance, accuracy, and potential data drift.

- Integrate third-party AI/ML services, including OpenAI, Azure AI services, and AWS SageMaker.

- Explore large language models (LLMs), generative AI tools, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

- Experience integrating AI/ML APIs or tools such as OpenAI, Azure AI services, AWS SageMaker, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.

- Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines.

## Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior Google Ads & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Peblx helps founders set up and run businesses in Hong Kong. We need a hands-on specialist to personally run Google Search and connect ad spend to qualified meetings and customers. You will recommend paid-search priorities, explain the numbers to the founder, and coordinate fixes across the lead journey. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. We use separate contractors for Webflow development and larger site changes.



LOCATION AND TERMS

Remote from the Philippines, with regular availability during Hong Kong business hours. Initial three-month independent contractor engagement, with potential to extend. Advertising spend is separate. Monthly compensation is PHP 80,000–105,000, depending on demonstrated experience.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Personally manage Google Search: search terms, negative keywords, match types, campaign structure, bids, budgets, ad copy, and a clear change log.

• Diagnose drops in lead quality or volume using Google Ads, GA4, GTM, booking records, and HubSpot. Distinguish button clicks, form submissions, confirmed bookings, meetings held, qualified meetings, and customers won.

• Keep conversion measurement accurate. Identify missing or duplicate events, specify the fix, work with a developer where code is needed, and test the full journey afterward.

• Spot landing-page and booking friction, write clear copy or change briefs, prioritize tests, and check the contractor's finished work. You are accountable for diagnosing and verifying the result; you are not expected to build the site.

• Report weekly on spend, changes made, qualified outcomes, cost per qualified meeting, and next decisions. Recommend what to stop, improve, or scale within an agreed budget.



WHAT WE NEED

• At least three years personally operating Google Search campaigns, with B2B or service-business lead-generation results.

• Sound judgment on search terms, negatives, limited budgets, and conversion actions. You can explain a decision using actual campaign data, including what you did yourself.

• Working knowledge of GA4, GTM, and CRM or booking reconciliation. HubSpot and Webflow familiarity is useful; coding and site design are not required.

• Clear written and spoken English, dependable Hong Kong-hours collaboration, and willingness to own the work personally. Agency experience is welcome if you were the hands-on operator.



FIRST MONTH

Audit the existing Ads account and conversion path; reconcile Ads, GA4, bookings, and HubSpot; correct the highest-priority measurement or campaign issues; and establish a weekly report tied to qualified meetings and customers. Agree a short, measurable testing backlog with the founder and brief the web contractor where needed.



CONTRACT AND TAXES

This is an independent contractor engagement. The compensation includes the contractor's own taxes, registrations, insurance, and required social contributions. The contractor is responsible for reporting and paying their own taxes and required contributions in their jurisdiction, subject to any withholding or other obligation that applicable law places on Peblx. The contractor will invoice Peblx and manage how they deliver the agreed work, with reasonable availability for collaboration in Hong Kong hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and one anonymized B2B or services Google Ads example: approximate monthly spend, the specific change you personally made, what the qualified-lead or meeting outcome was, and how you verified it. State your expected gross monthly compensation in PHP. Finalists will complete the same short, unseen live case by screen share. A calculator and fresh notes are allowed; AI, web search, and prepared answers are not allowed during the case. Identity and reference checks are part of the process.

title: DTC Meta Ads & Shopify Conversion Specialist — Supplement Brand
description:

description:
We are seeking a highly experienced, analytical, and technologically proficient Construction Accounting Manager to strengthen our accounting department, improve financial accuracy, and enhance companywide financial reporting.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of accounting execution, resolve discrepancies, strengthen financial controls, and leverage AI and automation to improve efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



Construction Accounting & Financial Reporting



Oversee daily accounting functions, including general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and reconciliations.



Prepare accurate monthly financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.



Manage accounting cleanup, investigate discrepancies, and maintain accurate financial records.



Support month-end and year-end closing, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow reporting.



Assist with lender reporting, borrowing-base certificates, audits, and financial compliance.



Establish consistent accounting procedures, reporting deadlines, and internal controls.



Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum ERP



Utilize Spectrum across general ledger, job costing, AP, AR, purchasing, payroll, and reporting.



Investigate posting errors, incorrect job allocations, and cost code discrepancies.



Reconcile financial transactions across integrated ERP modules.



Improve reporting accuracy, system utilization, and accounting workflows.



Project Accounting, Job Costing & WIP



Prepare and reconcile monthly WIP schedules.



Work directly with Project Managers to review job budgets, committed costs, actual costs, and estimated costs to complete.



Analyze percentage of completion, project profitability, projected gross margins, and cost variances.



Identify underbillings, overbillings, cost overruns, and margin deterioration.



Support accurate project forecasting, revenue recognition, and job closeout.



Construction Billing, Change Orders & T&M



Oversee progress billing, including AIA G702/G703 applications, schedules of values, and retainage.



Track pending, approved, disputed, and unbilled change orders.



Reconcile T&M tickets, labor, materials, equipment, and contractual markups.

Monitor billing deadlines, collections, and unbilled revenue.



Purchasing, AP/AR & Cost Controls

Verify accurate expense allocations across jobs and departments.



Identify duplicate payments, unrecorded costs, overbilling, and purchasing discrepancies.



Support payment planning and cash flow visibility.



Payroll & Labor Cost Accounting



Reconcile employee timesheets, payroll records, and job cost allocations.



Verify payroll burden and labor costs against approved field records.



Reconcile temporary labor invoices and subcontractor labor charges.



Support prevailing wage and certified payroll accounting requirements.



Identify inaccurate labor charges, cost codes, and payroll discrepancies.



AI, Technology & Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations, reporting, and repetitive accounting tasks.



Develop financial dashboards and improve the efficiency of existing workflows.



Utilize Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and ClickUp or similar productivity tools.



Maintain strict financial data security, confidentiality, and verification standards.



Required Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.



Minimum 5 years of professional accounting experience, including substantial U.S. construction accounting experience.



Proven hands-on experience with Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum ERP.



Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, financial statements, and internal controls.



Advanced knowledge of construction cost accounting, WIP, job costing, and revenue recognition.



Experience with AIA billing, change orders, T&M, retainage, and project financial reporting.



Strong experience in general ledger, AP, AR, purchasing, payroll reconciliations, and month-end closing.



Advanced Microsoft Excel and practical AI proficiency.



Excellent English communication, analytical skills, and attention to detail.



Ability to coordinate directly with Project Managers and accounting leadership.



Proven ability to independently resolve complex accounting discrepancies and consistently meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications



CPA or equivalent professional certification.



7+ years of U.S. construction accounting experience.



Previous Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accountant experience.



Specialty subcontractor accounting experience.



Experience managing accounting staff or supervising financial close processes.

What We're Looking For

title: WORKCOVER CLAIMS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
Biogenix Australia | Philippines-based | Work from home | Australian morning shift



We are a regenerative medicine and longevity clinic in Bankstown, Sydney. Many of our patients are treated under NSW workers compensation, and their treatment only

moves forward when the paperwork does. That is the job.



You MUST have worked on Australian workers compensation claims. Not insurance admin in another country, not general medical billing. Australian claims, with the codes, the insurers and the guidelines already familiar to you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Receive and chase GP and specialist referrals, and check they are complete

2. Prepare and send approval requests to insurers using our existing template, with the correct SIRA payment classification codes and supporting documents attached

3. Work our follow up tracker daily, call and
 case managers for outcomes, and action the 21 day follow up point without being reminded

4. Apply and update SIRA codes, and correct them when an insurer queries them

5. Chase, receive and upload scans, results and specialist reports to the patient

 file on the day they arrive

6. Build and maintain a clear clinical profile for each claims patient

7. Track certificate of capacity expiry dates and prompt for renewals

8. Send a short daily status on what was sent, approved, outstanding and at risk



WHAT YOU NEED

1. Proven hands-on experience in Australian workers compensation or personal injury claims, in a clinic, allied health practice, insurer or scheme agent

2. Working knowledge of SIRA payment classification codes, used without supervision

3. Familiarity with the SIRA Workers Compensation Guidelines, the fee orders, and what does and does not need pre approval

4. Direct dealings with Australian insurers and scheme agents such as icare, EML, Allianz, GIO, QBE and Gallagher Bassett, including calling case managers

5. You can explain the claims process end to end without it being explained to you

6. Strong written and spoken English, Australian spelling, professional on the phone

7. Genuinely tech savvy, quick to pick up new systems

8. Reliable internet with a backup, backup power, headset, and a quiet workspace



HOURS

Trial: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Sydney time, Monday to Friday, four hours a day

Ongoing: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Sydney time, Monday to Friday, full time



THE ARRANGEMENT

Two week paid trial at four hours a day on live files. At the end of week two, we review accuracy, quality, follow-through, communication and reliability. If it works, you move to full time and ongoing. Every trial hour is paid either way.



Rate: $9 AUD per hour

Independent contractor, direct with Biogenix Australia. No agencies.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to 
 with short answers to these five questions. Applications without the answers will not be read.

1. Which Australian insurers or scheme agents have you dealt with directly, and in what role

2. Walk us through how you would handle a new WorkCover referral, from the moment it arrives to the moment treatment is approved

3. How do you select the correct SIRA payment classification code, and what do you do when an insurer disputes it

4. Describe a claim you chased that had stalled, and what you did to move it

5. Confirm you can work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Sydney time



Please DO NOT apply if your insurance experience is from outside Australia only, you are applying for an agency, you cannot work Sydney morning hours, or you plan to hold another full-time role alongside this.

title: Producer | Founder-Led Content
description:
You've had this job before. You just never had the title.



You were the editor, the VA, the "content manager." But you were the one who actually ran the show. You built the process nobody asked for. You chased the founder for footage. You rebuilt the week around the session he missed. And when it went out late, YOU heard about it.



You can see the whole machine. You've just never been handed the keys.



I'm the founder. I'm the face. I'm the decision-maker. I am also, consistently, the bottleneck. I know it. I'm hiring you to fix it.



The Work



We're building a show: daily video content from me, turned into content everywhere my market lives, with paid promotion behind it. The system exists in my head (and in the process I run for my clients.) It does NOT (yet) exist on paper.



Job one is standing it up WITH me.

Scheduled working sessions, you and I, pulling the loop out of my head and into a production you can run.

You'll be in the room for the layout, not handed a manual afterward.



Job two is running it.

You own the schedule.

You get me in front of the camera.

You drive the raw through edit, audit, approval, and launch, and you don't let it sit.



I make the calls.

You make sure the calls get made, on time, and executed.



Job three is earned:

the loop gets tight enough that I only record and steer,

and YOU run the whole show.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED.



You start things and you don't let go.

A rough vision energizes you.

A founder who's hard to pin down doesn't scare you.



You've done this for someone else's face - and you were good at it.



The Offer



Direct access to the owner. A schedule that's yours to protect. Real authority over the production, starting day one. A show you helped design and then get to run. And a role that grows into showrunner if you earn it, because I'd rather promote the person who built it than hire over them.



To Apply



Tell me two things, briefly:



A time you turned someone's loose idea into a process that actually ran.

A time the person you depended on kept NOT delivering, and what you did about it.



In Closing



If you want to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you.

If you need a finished SOP before you can move, this isn't for you.

If what you really want is to be the strategist, this isn't for you either. (The decisions stay with me.)



But if you read the first ten lines and felt seen, you already know.

Send it!

title: B2B Sales Closer / Account Executive – US Market (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
# B2B Sales Closer / Account Executive – US Market (Remote, Part-Time)



**Company:** Imperium Solutions Inc.  

**Industry:** Outsourcing / Managed Customer Support / Back-Office Operations  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** Part-time initially, with availability during US business hours  

**Compensation:** $8–$15 USD/hour (depending on experience) + performance-based commissions  

**Growth Opportunity:** Potential to become Sales Team Lead



## About Us



Imperium Solutions Inc. provides managed customer support, virtual assistance, and back-office operations for businesses that need reliable, scalable support without the complexity of building and managing everything internally.



We're building a dedicated B2B sales operation targeting US businesses, particularly SaaS companies.



We already have outbound prospecting initiatives underway and are looking for an experienced closer who can turn qualified conversations into paying clients.



## The Role



We're looking for a **B2B Sales Closer / Account Executive** who understands how to sell services, not just products.



You'll take ownership of qualified sales opportunities, conduct discovery calls, understand operational challenges, present appropriate solutions, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close recurring service contracts.



This is not a high-volume cold-calling position. Our prospecting team will focus on identifying potential buyers and initiating conversations.



We need someone who can take those opportunities through the sales process and eventually help us build a repeatable, independently managed sales operation.



## Key Responsibilities



- Conduct discovery calls with US founders, COOs, operations managers, and customer support leaders.

- Identify business challenges involving customer support, staffing, coverage, response times, and operational efficiency.

- Qualify opportunities based on need, budget, authority, timing, and fit.

- Present Imperium's managed support and back-office services.

- Prepare proposals, recommend appropriate service packages, and negotiate within approved pricing guidelines.

- Manage follow-ups, objections, and deal progression through closing.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline stages, and sales forecasts.

- Coordinate with the operations team to ensure smooth onboarding of new clients.

- Collaborate with appointment setters to improve lead quality and messaging.

- Help develop sales scripts, qualification frameworks, and repeatable closing processes.



## Requirements



**Must have:**



- At least 2 years of B2B sales experience, preferably selling services to US companies.

- Demonstrated experience personally closing deals, not just generating leads or booking appointments.

- Strong English communication skills and confidence conducting live video sales calls.

- Experience handling discovery, objections, proposals, negotiations, and closing.

- Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar platforms.

- Ability to work independently and manage a sales pipeline.

- Availability for scheduled calls during US business hours.



**Strongly preferred:**



- Experience selling BPO, outsourcing, customer support, staffing, or managed services.

- Experience selling recurring monthly contracts rather than one-time products.

- Experience working with SaaS companies or technology businesses.

- Ability to build and improve sales processes.

- Previous experience mentoring SDRs or leading a small sales team.



## Compensation & Growth



- $8–$15 USD/hour depending on relevant experience.

- Performance-based commission for successfully closed and collected deals.

- Initially part-time, with hours based on qualified opportunity volume.

- Opportunity to increase hours as the sales pipeline grows.

- Potential advancement into a Sales Team Lead position.



We value measurable results, independent judgment, and long-term client relationships over aggressive sales tactics.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application. Generic applications that don't address these questions will not be prioritized.



**1. Your actual B2B closing experience**



Describe one B2B services campaign or sales role where you personally closed paying clients.



Include:

- What service you sold and to whom.

- Average deal size or monthly contract value.

- Number of deals you personally closed.

- Your specific responsibilities from discovery through closing.



Please distinguish deals you personally closed from appointments you booked or sales credited to your wider team.



**2. Your experience selling outsourcing or recurring services**



Have you sold BPO, outsourced customer support, staffing, managed services, or other recurring B2B services?



Describe your experience. If you haven't, explain which previous sales experience is most transferable.



**3. Sales scenario**



A 60-person US SaaS company is hiring three customer support representatives.



During your discovery call, the Head of Customer Support tells you:



"We've considered outsourcing, but we're worried an external team won't understand our product, and we'd lose control over quality. We'd rather hire internally."



How would you respond?



Explain how you'd investigate their concerns, determine whether outsourcing is actually a good fit, and move the opportunity forward without being overly pushy.



**4. Your sales process**



Walk us through how you manage a qualified opportunity from the first discovery call to a signed contract.



What steps do you take, and how do you prevent opportunities from going cold?



**5. Compensation and availability**



Please share:

- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your preferred commission structure.

- Your availability during US business hours.

- Whether you're comfortable starting part-time.



**6. Leadership potential**



Have you previously managed appointment setters, coached salespeople, or helped establish a sales process?



If yes, briefly describe what you owned and the results.



We will shortlist candidates based on relevant experience and the quality of their responses. Selected applicants may be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.



**We are looking for someone who can eventually own the sales process—not simply follow a script.**



We look forward to hearing from you.



**Imperium Solutions Inc.**
