title: Phone Sales Dialler
description:
🎯



**TL;DR:** We need experienced **outbound dialers** to make **200–400 calls a day** to warm leads and prospects already in our pipeline, and book them onto sales calls with our closers. Remote. **$500/month base + 5% commission on every deal you book that closes.** Must have outbound dialling experience, **perfect English**, and serious work ethic. **Read this page, apply at the link below, and submit an in-depth Loom video on why we should hire you: 
/hiring-setter**







# Why this role exists



We have more warm leads than we can call. Every day people opt in, apply, watch our VSL, come to our events and message us on Instagram. On top of that, there are hundreds of prospects already in our pipeline who spoke to us once and never got followed up properly.



Every one of those people put their hand up. When nobody calls them back fast, the money goes cold.



That is a **who** problem, not a **how** problem. You are the who.



Your job is simple: **pick up the phone, get the right people talking, and put qualified prospects on a call with our closers.** Do it 200–400 times a day, every day, and you will make yourself and this company a lot of money.



# Who we are



**7 Figure Scaling Systems (7FSS)**, founded by **Charlie Johnson**.



Charlie built one of the biggest online fitness coaching businesses in the UK. He has worked with **17,000+ clients**, generated **$20M+ online** across his companies, and won the **ClickFunnels Two Comma Club X award** (presented by Russell Brunson on stage in Las Vegas) for a single funnel that did over $10M.



Now we take everything that built that business and install it into other coaches' businesses: lead flow, sales, delivery, systems, team. We turn chaos into control and control into predictable income.



# Who you'll be calling



Our prospects are **online fitness coaches, personal trainers and fitness business owners**, mainly in the **US**, plus the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia and the UAE. They are typically:



- **Starting out** (under $10K/month): good coach, no predictable lead flow, posting content and hoping

- **Stuck in the middle** ($10K–$50K/month): busy and burnt out, doing everything themselves, no systems and no sales team

- **Ready to scale** ($50K+/month): need the team, operating rhythm and infrastructure to reach $100K–$200K months



They are not cold. Every person on your list has **already shown interest**: they opted in, applied, watched our VSL, bought an event ticket, booked a call before, or spoke to a closer and didn't sign yet.



# What we sell



You don't sell on the phone. You **qualify and book**. But you need to know what's on the other side of the call so you book the right people:



- **7FSS (7 Figure Scaling Systems):** our flagship mentorship. Coaching, systems and support to scale a fitness coaching business: lead generation, sales, client delivery, team and operations. For coaches who are already making money and want to scale.

- **FPLS:** our programme for coaches at an earlier stage who need the foundations in place first (offer, niche, lead flow and sales).

- **Live events and masterminds:** e.g. the **Scaling Summit** in Dubai.



Programmes are **high-ticket, typically several thousand dollars**. That's why the person you book must have the **money, the motivation and the decision-making power**. Booking someone who can't afford it wastes a closer's time and earns you nothing.



# What you'll actually do



- **Dial 200–400 times a day** through our dialer and CRM

- Call **new warm leads within minutes** of them coming in. Speed to lead wins.

- Work through the **existing pipeline**: no-shows, people who didn't close, people who went quiet, old applicants

- Qualify every conversation: where their business is today, where they want it to be, what's stopping them, whether they can invest, and whether they make the decision

- **Book qualified prospects straight into our closers' calendars** and get them committed to showing up

- Follow up by call, SMS and voi
 until you get an answer. One attempt is not follow-up.

- Log **every** dial, outcome and note in the CRM the same day. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.

- Post your numbers at end of day



# Our tools



- **Close CRM:** sales pipeline and dialer. Your call lists, notes and outcomes live here.

- **GoHighLevel (GHL):** lead capture, SMS follow-up and booking links

- **Slack:** team communication, booking notifications and EOD reports

- **Zoom:** where our closers run sales calls



Already used Close or GHL? Good, tell us. If you haven't, you'll need to learn them fast.



# The scorecard (how we measure you)



We don't measure hours. We measure output. This is your weekly scorecard:



| Metric | Target |

| --- | --- |

| Dials per day | 200 minimum, 400 is the standard |

| Speed to lead (new warm leads) | Called within 5 minutes during your shift |

| Qualified calls booked | Set in your first 2 weeks, based on your connect rate. Then it goes up. |

| Show rate on the calls you book | Above the team average |

| Booked calls that are qualified (money + decision maker) | 90%+ |

| CRM logging (every dial, outcome and note) | 100%, same day |

| EOD report posted | Every working day |



If your scorecard is green, nobody chases you about how you work. If it's red, we'll talk about it straight away. No surprises either way.



# Must-haves (non-negotiable)



- **Proven outbound dialling experience.** You've done high-volume outbound before (setting, SDR, appointment setting, call centre) and you can show us your numbers. No experience, no interview.

- **Perfect English.** Spoken and written. Our prospects are mainly American and British business owners. You have to sound confident, natural and easy to understand on the first "hello".

- **Huge work ethic and tenacity.** 200–400 dials a day means a lot of no's, voi
s and hang-ups. You keep going on call 300 the same way you did on call 1.

- **Thick skin.** Rejection doesn't slow you down. It's part of the job.

- **Organised.** Clean CRM, notes that a closer can read in 10 seconds, follow-ups never missed.

- **Reliable.** You show up for every shift, on time. If something's wrong, you say so before it becomes a problem.

- **Set-up:** quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and availability during **US and UK calling hours**



# Nice-to-haves



- Experience with **Close** and/or **GoHighLevel**

- Experience setting for **high-ticket coaching, consulting or info offers**

- Understanding of the **fitness / online coaching** industry

- Experience with SMS and DM follow-up alongside calls



# Who this is NOT for



Be honest with yourself. You'll hate this role if:



- You think 200 dials is a lot. For us it's the minimum.

- You need someone to motivate you every morning

- You take "no" personally

- You want a guaranteed salary without having to perform. Most of the money in this role is commission.

- You're looking for a side gig to do around something else



# Who this IS for



- You love the phone and you're competitive about your numbers

- You want uncapped earnings tied directly to what you produce

- You want to work with a fast-growing team that gives more responsibility (and more money) to people who earn it

- You eventually want to move into closing. The best dialers learn the offer, the prospect and the objections better than anyone.



# How we work (our values)



- **Success loves speed.** Call fast, follow up fast.

- **Extreme ownership.** Your pipeline, your numbers, your result. No excuses, no blame.

- **Dependability.** Do what you said, when you said you'd do it.

- **Organised and prepared.** The CRM is always up to date.

- **Open and honest, even when it's painful.** Tell us what's working and what isn't. We'll do the same.



# Your first 30 days



- **Week 1:** Get set up in Close, GHL and Slack. Learn our offers, our prospects and the script. Listen to recorded sales calls. Start dialling.

- **Week 2:** Full volume: 200+ dials a day. Calls booked onto closers' calendars.

- **Weeks 3–4:** 300–400 dials a day, a consistent booking number, and a show rate above the team average

- **Day 30:** Hitting your scorecard every week



# Compensation



- **$500/month base**

- **5% commission on every deal you book that closes**

- Uncapped. The more qualified calls you book, the more you earn.



**Example (illustrative only, not a promise):** our programmes are high-ticket. If 8 of the calls you book in a month close at $5,000 each, that's $40,000 in sales → **$2,000 commission + $500 base = $2,500** for the month. Double the closed deals, double the commission.



Remote, long-term role. Top performers get more leads, more responsibility, and a route into closing.



# How to apply



1. **Read this whole page.** If it's not for you, no hard feelings.

2. **Watch the full hiring video** at **
/hiring-setter**

3. **Click "Apply Now"** and complete the application

title: Sales Development & Administrative Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a motivated, persuasive, and highly organized Sales Development & Administrative Specialist to help generate new sales opportunities while keeping our sales pipeline organized and running smoothly.



This is a hands-on role that combines outbound prospecting with sales coordination and administrative support. You’ll reach out to potential clients, start meaningful sales conversations, identify qualified leads, and schedule discovery calls or meetings. You’ll also maintain accurate CRM records, coordinate follow-ups, prepare sales documents, and support the sales team throughout the sales process.



The ideal candidate is comfortable picking up the phone, handling objections, and building rapport with prospects while also enjoying the behind-the-scenes work that keeps sales operations efficient. You’ll play an important role in ensuring opportunities don’t get overlooked, information stays accurate, and the sales team has what it needs to move deals forward.



If you’re a proactive self-starter who combines strong communication skills with excellent organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through, this could be an excellent fit.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

- Make daily outbound calls to targeted prospects to introduce the company’s services and generate interest.

- Follow established calling scripts and prospecting strategies while adapting conversations naturally to each prospect.

- Communicate the company’s value proposition clearly and professionally.

- Identify decision-makers, understand prospect needs, and determine whether they are a good fit for the company’s offerings.

- Handle gatekeepers, initial resistance, and objections with confidence and professionalism.

- Recognize buying signals and turn promising conversations into qualified sales opportunities.

- Schedule discovery calls, demonstrations, and follow-up meetings with qualified prospects.

- Maintain consistent outreach activity and work toward established sales and lead-generation targets.



Lead Qualification & Sales Coordination

- Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, challenges, interests, and readiness to move forward.

- Evaluate lead quality based on established qualification criteria.

- Ensure qualified leads are assigned or transitioned to the appropriate sales representative.

- Coordinate discovery calls, meetings, demonstrations, and other sales activities.

- Follow up with prospects to confirm appointments, gather missing information, and maintain engagement.

- Monitor lead progress and help ensure prospects receive timely communication throughout the sales process.

- Support the sales team in maintaining momentum with active opportunities.



CRM & Sales Data Management

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect and customer information in the CRM.

- Record outbound calls,
s, prospect responses, conversation notes, outcomes, and follow-up schedules.

- nUpdate lead statuses, deal stages, contact information, and other pipeline details.

- Ensure prospect records are complete, organized, and properly documented.

- Identify and correct missing, outdated, or inconsistent information.

- Use CRM platforms and sales engagement tools to track outreach activity, manage follow-ups, and monitor pipeline progress.

- Ensure qualified leads and relevant prospect information are properly documented before handoff.



Sales Administration & Documentation

- Prepare, review, and distribute standard sales quotes, proposals, agreements, and related documents as needed.

- Verify that required information, pricing, terms, and internal approvals are complete before documents are sent.

- Track outstanding forms, signatures, and supporting documentation.

- Follow up with prospects or clients regarding missing information and incomplete paperwork.

- Maintain organized sales records throughout the opportunity and deal lifecycle.

- Assist sales representatives with administrative tasks so they can focus on prospect engagement and closing opportunities.



Sales Team Support & Internal Coordination

- Serve as a reliable support partner to sales representatives and sales leadership.

- nCoordinate communication between prospects, customers, and internal team members.

- Ensure sales opportunities are properly documented and transferred between team members.

- Track outstanding action items and follow up to keep deals progressing.

- Communicate important prospect feedback, objections, and sales activity updates to the appropriate team members.

- Help identify delays, recurring administrative issues, and opportunities to improve sales workflows.



Reporting & Performance Tracking

- Track daily calling activity, outreach results, qualified leads, appointments booked, and follow-up completion.

- Compile regular sales activity reports and maintain accurate performance records.

- Monitor lead conversion, pipeline progress, and other established sales metrics.

- Help identify trends in prospect responses, objections, and lead quality.

- Provide sales leadership with reliable information to support decision-making and improve team performance.

- Use results and feedback to identify opportunities to improve prospecting strategies and administrative processes.



What We’re Looking For

- We’re looking for someone who is confident on the phone, organized behind the scenes, results-driven, and dependable.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in cold calling, outbound sales, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, sales administration, sales coordination, or a similar role.

- Strong English communication skills, with a clear, engaging, and professional telephone voice.

- The ability to build rapport quickly and communicate a value proposition confidently.

- Excellent active listening, objection-handling, and lead qualification skills.

- Resilience and a positive attitude when dealing with rejection or challenging conversations.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing prospect records, sales documents, and follow-ups.

- Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar systems.

- Familiarity with auto-dialers, sales engagement platforms, office productivity tools, and communication software.

- Strong written communication skills for
s, sales documentation, and internal updates.

- The ability to manage multiple prospects, administrative tasks, and deadlines without losing track of priorities.

- Excellent follow-through and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

- A target-driven mindset with the ability to balance daily sales activity and administrative accuracy.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means generating qualified sales opportunities while ensuring the administrative side of the sales process remains accurate, organized, and efficient.



You’ll help ensure:

- Consistent outbound calling and prospecting activity.

- Meaningful conversations with prospective clients and accurate lead qualification.

- A steady flow of qualified leads and well-scheduled sales appointments.

- Professional handling of objections and effective prospect follow-up.

- Accurate and up-to-date CRM records, call logs, and pipeline information.

- Timely communication and proper handoff of qualified opportunities to sales representatives.

- Sales documents, proposals, and outstanding signatures are tracked and processed efficiently.

- Sales representatives have the information and support they need to move deals forward.

- Sales activity reports and performance metrics are reliable and current.

- Prospects receive a professional and consistent experience from the first call through the next stages of the sales process.



Why This Role Matters



Successful sales operations require both strong prospecting and reliable execution. Generating interest is only the beginning; every lead also needs accurate documentation, timely follow-up, and proper coordination.



In this role, you’ll contribute directly to business growth by creating new opportunities, maintaining an organized sales pipeline, and helping the sales team work more efficiently. Your communication skills, persistence, and attention to detail will help ensure promising opportunities don’t fall through the cracks.



How to Apply



If you enjoy speaking with new people, generating sales opportunities, staying organized, and helping a sales team achieve its goals, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume in English along with:



A brief statement highlighting your experience in cold calling, lead generation, sales administration, or CRM management.



We’re looking for someone who can confidently open doors, keep information organized, and consistently follow through to help turn sales opportunities into results.

title: ₱10,000 Referral Fee – Help Us Find a Private Country Home for Rent in Luzon

Hii !



We're searching for a genuinely private and peaceful home to rent long-term in rural Luzon (6 Months to 1+ year), and we're offering a ₱10,000 referral fee to anyone who introduces us to a property we ultimately lease.



We're not looking for luxury. We're looking for privacy, peace, natural surroundings, and a comfortable place to call home.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR...



:)  A standalone house, farmhouse, rest house, or private residential property surrounded by nature.

:)  Genuine privacy is our highest priority. Ideally, no immediate neighbors, nearby houses, or properties above the home.

:)  A generous amount of surrounding land, trees, farmland, or open space.

:)  A comfortable, livable house with electricity, running water, and reliable internet (or ability for us to have StarLink).

:)  Accessible by an ordinary vehicle throughout the year.

:)  Suitable for long-term rental rather than short-term vacation stays.

:)  Pet-friendly (two indoor cats).



LOCATION...



We're looking for rural properties in Luzon, within a maximum of approximately 4 hours' driving distance from Metro Manila in any direction. We're particularly interested in peaceful agricultural communities, mountain foothills, and countryside locations with plenty of open space and privacy.



We're flexible about the province, but the 4-hour-ish driving limit is important because we need reasonable access to Metro Manila, including the airport and government services.



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR...



:(  Subdivisions, gated communities, or densely populated neighborhoods.

:(  Homes with immediate neighbors or shared residential compounds.

:(  Properties along busy roads or surrounded by commercial activity.

:(  Vacation resorts that aren't available for long-term rental.

:(  Homes that appear private in photographs but are actually surrounded by other houses.



HOW THE REFERRAL FEE WORKS...



If you introduce us to a suitable property and we ultimately sign a rental agreement, we'll pay you ₱10,000 upon signing the lease! You don't need to be a real estate agent. Perhaps a relative owns an unused farmhouse, a neighbor has a vacant countryside property, or you simply know someone who might be willing to rent their home.



We're particularly interested in privately owned properties that may not be advertised online.



This is not an hourly position or a request for online property research. It's a referral opportunity with a one-time payment for a successful introduction.



INTERESTED? LET'S TALK!



If you know of a property that might be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you! You don't need to have everything ready when you first contact us. A simple introduction about a potential property is perfectly fine.



However, anyone pursuing the ₱10,000 referral fee will be responsible for contacting the property owner, confirming their willingness to rent long-term, and gathering the information we need to evaluate the property. This includes photos of the house and surrounding area, the proposed rental price, and a Google Maps location pin so we can examine the property and its surroundings using satellite imagery.



Privacy is extremely important to us, so being able to verify the property's location and proximity to neighboring houses is essential before arranging a viewing. We're happy to discuss promising leads, but we're looking for someone who can help facilitate the introduction and communication with the owner, not simply provide a name or address.

Thanks so much!!

title: ₱10,000 Referral Bonus – Help Us Find a Secluded Rural Rental Home in Luzon
description:
Hello!!



My wife and I are looking for a long-term rental home somewhere in rural Luzon, generally within about 3–4 hours by road from Metro Manila.



We are not looking for a subdivision house, city property, or normal residential neighborhood.



We are looking for something genuinely secluded — a simple but comfortable home surrounded by farmland, trees, mountains, open land, or similar rural surroundings.



Privacy matters more to us than luxury.



We have already searched the normal online channels, including
 Marketplace, Airbnb, and real-estate contacts. The kind of property we want rarely seems to appear publicly.



So this posting is different....What I’m really looking for is word of mouth.



I’m looking for people who are willing to ask around within their own personal networks — family, friends, hometown contacts, neighbors, former coworkers, provincial contacts, friends of friends, etc.



The property does not need to already be advertised for rent. It could be an unused but livable family home, farmhouse, rest house, retirement property, caretaker house, or another private property where the owner might consider a long-term tenant if approached.



If a property you introduce ultimately results in my wife and me signing a lease, I will pay you a ₱10,000 one-time referral bonus.



There is no hourly work, no required number of leads, and no need to spend time scraping property websites.



This is really about personal connections and uncovering properties that may never appear online.



If this sounds interesting, just let me know where you’re based and what areas or provinces you have personal or family connections to. If it looks like there may be a fit, I’ll send over a short set of guidelines and budget information explaining exactly what we’re looking for and what information needs to come with any lead.



We are ready to move once the right property is found, and we’d be excited to take a road trip to personally visit any location that looks especially promising!



Thank you in Advance!

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are an e-commerce and digital consultancy acting as the fractional digital and e-commerce lead for a portfolio of premium fashion, swimwear, and lifestyle brands across the United States and Australia. We are looking for an exceptional Paid Media Specialist to own day-to-day execution across Meta and Google.



This person will live in the ad accounts every working day, keep tracking and product feeds healthy, build campaigns, and give honest, clear reads on what is and isn't working. Strategy, budgets, and commercial targets are set at the leadership level; this role owns the execution underneath them, starting with a premium swimwear brand and potentially expanding to additional accounts as the business grows.



This is not a coordinator or assistant role. It is a hands-on performance marketing position for someone who wants ownership of real budgets across real brands.
, SMS, Klaviyo lifecycle work, and dashboard building are outside the scope of this role.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential to move to full-time as accounts are added

Location: Remote

Timezone: Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap required

Compensation: 10 USD

Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and own computer required



Key Responsibilities



Meta Advertising

Check every ad account daily for pacing, delivery, frequency, creative fatigue, and overnight issues

Build and restructure campaigns to a specified architecture while maintaining tight edit hygiene to avoid resetting the learning phase

Diagnose and fix accounts stuck in the learning phase with a genuine understanding of the underlying mechanics

Run a structured creative testing framework with disciplined naming conventions so results remain readable over time

Manage catalogue work, including dynamic product ads, Advantage+ catalogue ads, and collection ads



Google Advertising

Manage Performance Max, Standard Shopping, and brand and non-brand Search campaigns

Keep brand and non-brand performance reported separately so brand traffic is not mistaken for growth

Tracking & Product Feeds

Maintain Meta pixel, Conversions API, and server-side event health, including event match quality and deduplication

Troubleshoot tracking issues, especially when tracking breaks silently

Manage Google Merchant Center feed setup, diagnostics, disapprovals, and product data quality

Enforce UTM discipline across every campaign



Budget & Campaign Execution

Pace monthly budgets daily by brand, channel, and market, flagging potential overspend early

Advise on where and when budgets can be scaled

Traffic, name, and QA all creative assets provided by brand teams

Build every paid campaign to the trading and campaign calendar, on time



Paid Media Reporting

Deliver a weekly written update on Meta and Google performance by campaign, creative, and channel, with a focus on MER, CAC, and ROAS

Analyse creative performance and feed insights back to inform content strategy

Clearly explain gaps between platform-reported numbers, GA4, and Shopify data

Build and maintain a weekly reporting spreadsheet tracking all key metrics

Provide a short written daily handover at the end of each working day



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: Minimum 4 years of hands-on paid social and paid search experience for e-commerce brands, ideally in fashion, apparel, beauty, or another considered-purchase category. Agency experience is welcome, provided the candidate tailors strategy to each brand's catalogue, price point, and audience rather than relying on templates



Strategy: Solid understanding of brand vs. performance marketing, blended attribution, and customer acquisition



Meta: Business Manager and Ads Manager administration across multiple ad accounts; knows when to use Advantage+ Shopping vs. manual campaigns; deep understanding of the learning phase, including conversion thresholds, consolidation, significant edits, frequency, and audience overlap; audience strategy across broad, interest, lookalike, and retargeting with correct exclusions



Google: Google Ads including Performance Max, Shopping, and Search; Google Merchant Center feeds and diagnostics; GA4 to a working standard, including events, conversions, channel groupings, and exploration reports



Tracking: Meta pixel and Conversions API setup and debugging, event match quality, and UTM discipline; able to spot broken tracking before anyone flags it



Analytics: Confident in Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, clean reporting) and comfortable discussing MER, CAC, blended ROAS, and incrementality



Communication: Excellent written English; weekly updates may be client-facing and must be clear, professional, and free of filler



Working Style: In the accounts every working day, raises problems before being asked, and is comfortable saying I don't know, let me find out



Attention to Detail: Obsessive about craft; issues like a cropped logo, broken link, wrong price, or incorrect size guide are never treated as minor



Discretion: Absolute confidentiality is required, as this role has visibility into revenue, margin, and ad spend across competing brands



Reliability: Consistent hours, highly responsive, and proactive about flagging leave well in advance



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Graphic Designer (Meta Static Ads, DTC)
description:
Graphic Designer (Meta Static Ads, DTC)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience, with a clear path to increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Resources is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We run a full creative system: strategy, statics, video, and UGC. You'll work directly with Matt, ABG Resources' CMO, alongside our Creative Strategist, and ship high volume Meta static ads that convert.



We're an AI-forward team. We expect heavy use of AI tools for research, ideation, production, and iteration: Midjourney/ChatGPT Images for concepts, backgrounds, and fast variations; ChatGPT/Claude for headline and hook options. AI gets you to concepts faster, but you ship polished, on-brand final statics, and human judgment owns the design call and compliance.



Role Overview

You will design static ads and ad graphics for high-growth ecommerce brands in niches like natural wellness supplements and international consumer products running Meta ads in the US, Europe and Australia. You own Meta static ad production — roughly 100 finished statics per month across our brands. Fast, on-brief, direct-response design (not brand-identity only). Clean layouts, strong hooks on-image, mobile-first.



Key Responsibilities

- Design ~100 Meta static ads per month (1:1 and 9:16) from CS briefs

- Iterate winners with new hooks/layouts within 24-48 hours

- Keep brand product photography accurate; no fake claims on-image

- Organize files in shared drive; name for Ads Manager upload

- Light Canva/Figma mockups when needed for speed

- Use AI (Midjourney, ChatGPT Images, Photoshop Generative Fill) to explore concepts and speed up production, then finish to a polished, accurate standard



Requirements

- 2+ years designing paid social statics for ecommerce/DTC

- Portfolio of real Meta/Facebook ads (not only logos or social posts)

- Strong typography, hierarchy, and mobile readability

- Photoshop and/or Figma; Canva OK as secondary

- Comfortable using AI image tools daily as part of your workflow

- Clear written English; US Central overlap 3-4 hrs/day



How to Apply

Subject line must start with: CLEAN STATICS

If you're not a problem solver, do not apply.

Apply with 3 to 5 real ad statics you designed that ran as paid ads.

Include: portfolio link, 2-3 sample Meta statics, monthly rate confirmation, and your hours overlapping US Central.

title: Real Estate Deal Closer
description:
Hi! We’re launching a real estate wholesaling business focused on houses, teardowns, and land for luxury developers. We’re looking for an experienced real estate pro to join us.



The process is simple:



Contact developers

Get their buy box (what they’re looking for)

Find a matching property

Contact a seller

Make an offer

Close the deal



Our AI does most of the heavy lifting. It researches properties, finds developer matches, drafts messages, and supports negotiation. Your job is to review its work, catch mistakes, use your judgment on which deals are worth pursuing, and help close them.



Pay



First month: $300 base (up to 15 hrs/week), plus bonuses. This is a paid trial, and the rate is the same for everyone. It gives you time to learn our system and market, and gives both of us a chance to see if it’s a good fit before committing long-term.

Closing bonuses: $100 to $1,000 per deal, plus extra bonuses for your first closing and for big deals.

After the first month, you can earn $2,000+ per month, depending on the deals you close.



Bonuses are paid once the company receives the assignment fee.



You’re a great fit if you have:



Experience in U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispositions

Real deals you’ve helped negotiate and close

Good English, organization, and follow-up

Bonus: experience with developers, land, teardowns, or luxury properties



Cold calling or appointment setting experience alone isn’t enough for this role.



To apply, please answer:



How many deals have you helped close, and what was your role?

What types of properties and markets have you worked in?

How do you d
 if a property is a good deal for a buyer?

Are you comfortable with the $300 first-month trial?

What hours and U.S. time zones can you work?



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Executive Operations Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING: SENIOR EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS MANAGER



Full-Time | Work From Home | Philippines | Australian Company



Salary: AUD $2,500-$3,500 per month (depending on experience)



We are looking for an exceptional operations manager who knows how to run meetings, manage accountability and make sure a business operates properly.



We are an Australian digital marketing company generating approximately AUD $6 million in annual revenue.



We have an established team, systems, processes and KPIs.



We are now looking for a highly organised, confident and experienced person to work directly with our CEO to ensure our team consistently follows those systems and delivers on its commitments.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant position.



We don’t need someone to manage
s, book appointments or complete basic administrative tasks.



We need someone who can confidently run meetings, hold managers accountable, monitor performance and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You will be a critical part of our leadership team.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is simple:



Make sure our team does what they are supposed to do, when they are supposed to do it.



Our CEO will remain responsible for business strategy, innovation and major decisions.



Your responsibility will be ensuring that our existing systems, processes and expectations are consistently followed.



You will work across departments including sales, marketing, advertising, onboarding and customer service.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



1. Running Excellent Meetings



You will lead regular meetings with our team and department managers.



You must be comfortable:



* Running structured meetings confidently.

* Keeping meetings productive and engaging.

* Asking difficult questions when necessary.

* Making sure everyone participates.

* Ensuring every meeting finishes with clear action items.

* Following up on commitments from previous meetings.



We want someone who genuinely enjoys running meetings and is excellent at it.



2. Managing Accountability



You will ensure our managers and team members consistently meet their responsibilities.



This includes:



* Following up on missed deadlines.

* Checking that assigned tasks have been completed.

* Holding managers accountable for their commitments.

* Identifying when staff are not following company processes.

* Escalating ongoing issues to the CEO.



You must be comfortable having direct conversations with people about their performance.



3. Managing KPIs and Reporting



Our company operates using performance targets and reporting.



You will be responsible for:



* Ensuring department KPIs are updated.

* Reviewing daily and weekly performance.

* Identifying missed targets.

* Preparing clear reports for the CEO.

* Highlighting performance issues.

* Making sure department managers understand their numbers.



You don’t need to create our business strategy.



You need to make sure our existing performance systems are being used correctly.



4. Ensuring Systems Are Followed



We already have established systems and processes.



Your responsibility is to make sure everyone follows them.



This includes:



* Monitoring compliance with SOPs.

* Checking that required processes are completed.

* Identifying when systems are being ignored.

* Following up with the responsible manager.

* Reporting recurring problems to the CEO.



5. Supporting the CEO



You will work closely with our CEO to ensure the business operates efficiently.



You will provide clear updates covering:



* What is working well.

* What is not working.

* Which departments are meeting their targets.

* Which managers need additional accountability.

* What problems require the CEO’s attention.

* What actions have been completed.



Your goal is to help the CEO spend less time chasing staff and more time growing the company.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with the following experience and qualities:



Required:



* At least 5 years of relevant experience in operations management, executive operations or team management.

* Previous experience working directly with a CEO or senior business leader.

* Experience running meetings with managers or department leaders.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Strong experience managing KPIs and performance reports.

* Experience holding employees and managers accountable.

* Excellent organisational and time management skills.

* Confidence communicating with senior employees.

* Experience working with Australian, American or other international companies.

* Strong skills with spreadsheets, reporting tools and task management systems.



Your personality matters just as much as your experience.



You should be:



* Extremely organised.

* Confident but respectful.

* Comfortable challenging people.

* Proactive with follow-ups.

* Calm under pressure.

* Highly dependable.

* Direct in your communication.

* Someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities.



We do not want someone who simply agrees with everything the CEO says.



We want someone who can confidently say:



“This manager hasn’t completed their commitments for the third week in a row. Here is what happened, what I’ve done about it and what I recommend we do next.”



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is important.



We are NOT looking for someone to:



* Create new business strategies.

* Develop new products.

* Change our business model.

* Make major financial decisions.

* Run our marketing campaigns.

* Work as a general administrative assistant.



We already have our business model and systems.



We need someone exceptional at making sure they are executed consistently.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time, long-term employment.

* Work from home in the Philippines.

* AUD $2,500 - 3,500 monthly salary, depending on experience.

* Direct access to the CEO.

* An important role within an established international business.

* Opportunity to work with experienced department managers.

* Clear responsibilities and performance expectations.

* A company that values accountability, communication and results.



Working hours will need to overlap with our leadership team’s schedule.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Please read this section carefully.



We receive a large number of applications.



We are not interested in generic cover letters, copy-and-paste applications or AI-generated responses that do not reflect your actual experience.



To be considered, you MUST answer every question below.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Question 1: Your Experience



Tell us about the most senior operations or management position you have held.



Include:



* Your job title.

* The type of company.

* Approximately how many employees you were responsible for.

* How many years you held the position.

* Whether you reported directly to the CEO.



Question 2: Running Meetings



Tell us about your experience running meetings.



How many meetings did you typically run each week?



Who attended those meetings?



What did you do to ensure meetings were productive and people completed their commitments?



Question 3: Accountability



Imagine you are managing accountability across our company.



One department manager has failed to complete their agreed tasks for three consecutive weeks.



They always have an excuse.



Explain exactly how you would handle this situation.



We want to understand how you think and communicate.



Question 4: KPI Management



What KPIs have you personally been responsible for tracking in previous positions?



What tools did you use?



How did you handle situations where a department consistently missed its targets?



Question 5: Working With a CEO



Our CEO does not want to spend his day chasing staff or checking whether systems are being followed.



Explain how you would structure your daily and weekly communication with him so that he stays informed without becoming involved in every small issue.



Question 6: Your Biggest Achievement



Tell us about one specific example where you improved accountability, team performance or operational consistency in a previous company.



What was the problem?



What did you personally do?



What was the measurable result?



Question 7: Video Introduction



Record a 2-3 minute video introducing yourself.



In your video, please explain:



* Your previous management experience.

* Why you enjoy running meetings and managing accountability.

* Why you believe you would be excellent in this position.



Please share a link to your video.



We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, confidently and professionally.



Question 8: Salary and Availability



Please confirm:



* Your expected monthly salary in AUD.

* Your earliest available start date.

* Whether you can work full-time.

* Your experience working with international teams.



FINAL APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



To confirm you have read the entire job advertisement, please start your application with the following sentence:



“Accountability creates results.”



Applications that do not include this sentence at the beginning will not be considered.



Please send us via
 with your resume to 



Subject - Senior Executive Operations Manager - NAME



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with our company.



If you are confident, organised, experienced and genuinely enjoy making sure teams perform at their best, we would love to hear from you.

title: Accountant - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re not a lodgement factory. We work in our clients’ files every day, keep their books current, and give them advice they can actually act on. We’d rather have fewer clients we know well than hundreds we barely talk to.



We’re looking for an Accountant to take ownership of a portfolio of hospitality clients, lead compliance across all entity types, and be the person clients trust when they need a straight answer. You’ll work closely with the Director, review the work of our bookkeeping and accounting team, and help shape how we deliver advisory as the firm grows.



What you’ll do

▪ Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships

▪ Review BAS/IAS and oversee payroll compliance, including STP, super and award-based wages

▪ Manage your own client portfolio – be their main point of contact and keep work moving to deadline

▪ Review and coach the work of bookkeepers and junior accountants, and help build our review processes

▪ Deliver practical advisory: cash flow forecasts, budgets, wage and cost-of-goods analysis, restructures and business purchases

▪ Deal with the ATO on clients’ behalf, including payment plans, objections and queries

▪ Help onboard new clients and scope engagements with the Director



What you’ll bring

▪ CA or CPA qualified (or well progressed towards it)

▪ 5 years’ experience in an Australian practice

▪ Solid working knowledge of tax and compliance across all entity types

▪ Strong Xero skills plus experience with XPM, Dext, Deputy and FoundU

▪ Confidence talking to business owners in plain English and managing your own workload

▪ Experience reviewing others’ work and giving useful feedback

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation, POS integrations, and a registered tax agent pathway



Answer these three questions to be considered:

1. What is your process on compiling EOFY Workpaper?

2. How many years of experience do you have in Australian taxation?

3. Do you also have experience in doing bookkeeping tasks?

title: Motion Designer — SaaS & Performance Creative
description:
We’re looking for a senior-level Motion Designer to create premium, conversion-focused motion graphics for Layer Insights.



Layer Insights helps e-commerce brands understand the full customer journey: how customers move between Meta, Google,
, and other channels before converting. We need someone who can turn complex tracking, attribution, and data concepts into simple, visually compelling videos.

This is not a basic video-editing role. We need a strong visual storyteller who can create polished 2D explainer videos and paid-social creatives from scratch.



What you’ll do

- Create high-end 2D motion-graphic videos for paid social, landing pages, and product marketing.

- Turn scripts and strategic concepts into clear storyboards and visual narratives.

- Design and animate original visual systems: data flows, dashboards, customer journeys, platform touchpoints, UI cards, graphs, and campaign-performance concepts.

- Create scroll-stopping hooks and clear visual explanations for complex e-commerce and marketing topics.

- Develop a consistent motion language for the Layer Insights brand.

- Work closely with the founder/marketing team to refine concepts, scripts, pacing, and creative direction.

- Deliver vertical social ads, primarily in 9:16, as well as other formats when needed.



What we’re looking for

- Strong portfolio in premium 2D motion design, SaaS explainers, performance creative, or product storytelling.

- Excellent command of After Effects and Illustrator; Figma is a strong plus.

- Strong understanding of typography, composition, timing, easing, transitions, and visual hierarchy.

- Ability to create custom animated illustrations and data visualizations—not just edit stock footage or add captions.

- Experience designing for paid social and understanding how to hold attention in the first 1–3 seconds.

- Comfortable taking an abstract topic and making it feel simple, visual, and engaging.

- Strong taste: clean, modern, premium, and detail-oriented.

- Fluent written English.



Nice to have

- Experience with e-commerce, paid media, attribution, analytics, or marketing technology.

- Experience with UI animation, Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4D, or Blender.

- Sound-design and voice-over direction skills.

- Experience creating creative systems that can be reused across multiple ads.



Example project

Create a 30–60 second vertical motion-graphics video explaining why e-commerce brands need full customer-journey tracking:

A customer may discover a brand through Meta, return through Google, and convert later through
. Without seeing that full path, brands cannot tell which channels created demand, which channels converted it, or how long conversion takes. Layer Insights brings this data together and sends the right signals back to advertising platforms, helping brands d
 which campaigns to scale, optimise, or stop.



How to apply

Please send:

- Your portfolio or 3–5 relevant examples

- At least one 2D motion-graphics explainer or SaaS/product video

- Your rate and availability

- A short note explaining how you would approach the example project above

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Senior IT Project Manager (MSP) | 8+ Years IT | $20-$25/hr
description:
AllSafe IT is hiring a Senior Technical IT Project Manager with a strong infrastructure engineering background. You will own client projects from technical planning and design through implementation, troubleshooting, cutover, validation, documentation, and help desk handoff. You must be able to work at an engineering level while managing scope, budgets, schedules, and client communication.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role for someone based in the Philippines. A minimum of 8 years of overall relevant IT experience is required. Your background may include engineering, systems/network/cloud administration, technical support, IT leadership, and project delivery. You must also demonstrate ownership of IT projects from planning through delivery.



Pay and schedule



- USD $20-$25 per hour, depending on demonstrated relevant experience.

- 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM US Pacific Time. Your schedule follows US daylight saving changes. This is an overnight shift in the Philippines.

- At 40 hours per week, the annualized monthly equivalent is approximately $3,467-$4,333. Actual pay is based on hours worked.

- You will work directly with our team.



What you'll own



You will lead multiple client infrastructure projects, including client onboarding, Windows server and Active Directory changes, Microsoft 365 and Azure migrations, virtualization and storage, new office networks, firewall and security deployments, backup and disaster recovery, and enterprise telephony. You will understand the architecture, implementation sequence, risks, and recovery options and take personal responsibility for technical delivery.



Your responsibilities include:



- Turn an agreed scope into a project plan with tasks, owners, dependencies, milestones, resource assignments, and budgeted hours.

- Keep project plans, notes, decisions, schedules, and status current in ConnectWise.

- Lead kickoff, progress, and closeout meetings. Give clients clear updates on what is complete, what comes next, and any decisions they need to make.

- Architect, implement, troubleshoot, and validate infrastructure solutions within your expertise. Lead engineers and vendors effectively, review their technical work, and resolve implementation blockers.

- Track budget against actual hours, identify scope changes, and obtain the appropriate decisions and approvals before extra work proceeds.

- Raise risks and delays early, with their impact and a proposed next step.

- Own cutover and rollback planning, testing, technical documentation, acceptance, and operational handoff to the help desk.



What we're looking for



- At least 8 years of overall relevant IT experience, with a demonstrated track record of owning IT project scope, schedules, budgets, client communication, and delivery. Your work history should show your engineering, support, administration, leadership, and project responsibilities. MSP or other client-facing IT services experience is especially relevant.

- Strong spoken and written English, careful listening, and the ability to clarify a request and explain technical progress in plain language.

- Working knowledge of ConnectWise project workflows, or a comparable PSA platform with the ability to become effective in ConnectWise quickly.

- A demonstrated engineering background in infrastructure, systems, networking, cloud, or a comparable technical delivery role. You must show personal design, implementation, troubleshooting, and validation responsibilities in real infrastructure projects.

- Strong experience across relevant infrastructure domains such as Windows Server and AD/Entra identity, Microsoft 365/Azure, networks and firewalls, virtualization/storage, backup/disaster recovery, and enterprise voice. Equivalent vendor experience is accepted; every product is not required.

- The ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues, evaluate designs and dependencies, lead cutovers, and develop rollback and recovery plans.

- CRM implementation, marketing automation, administrative coordination, and software product delivery alone do not meet this infrastructure requirement.

- Consistent organization and follow-through across multiple clients and a distributed team.

- A reliable computer, internet connection, and workspace suitable for client video calls.



Substantial engineering or advanced technical-delivery experience, combined with proven infrastructure project delivery, is expected. PMP, ITIL, and relevant Microsoft, networking, security, or virtualization credentials support demonstrated experience; they do not replace it.



How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your resume with month/year dates for your IT roles, showing at least 8 years of overall relevant IT experience. Highlight your project-delivery responsibilities separately. Count overlapping roles once; eight years exclusively in project management is not required.

2. Two substantial infrastructure projects you delivered. For each, name the infrastructure involved, your personal design/configuration/troubleshooting actions, the cutover and rollback approach, validation, scope, timeline, budget or resource hours, and result. Separate what you personally did from work done by other engineers. Please leave out confidential client information.

3. Your experience with ConnectWise or other project management and PSA tools.

4. A link to a 1-2 minute introduction video explaining one infrastructure project, the technical problem and your own engineering contribution, and how you kept the client informed.

5. Confirmation that you can work the Pacific schedule, your earliest start date, and your expected hourly rate.

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

title: # B2B Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist — US Market
description:
We’re looking for an experienced **B2B Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist** to help us build a predictable outbound client acquisition system for our managed customer support and back-office services.



This is **not a basic list-building or data-entry role**.



We need someone who has personally helped generate **qualified B2B sales appointments** for agencies, BPOs, outsourcing companies, SaaS companies, consulting firms, or other B2B service businesses.



## What You'll Do



You’ll help manage the outbound process from prospect identification through appointment booking, including:



* Identifying companies showing relevant **buying signals**

* Finding the correct decision-makers

* Building and verifying targeted prospect lists

* Creating segmented cold
 and LinkedIn campaigns

* Writing relevant outreach and follow-ups

* Managing replies and qualifying interested prospects

* Booking qualified sales appointments

* Tracking everything properly in our CRM

* Reviewing campaign performance and improving what isn't working



We are **not interested in blasting thousands of generic leads**.



We want to reach companies where there is a clear reason for us to start a conversation.



For example, a company actively hiring multiple customer support representatives may already have a capacity problem and an approved budget. Your job is to identify opportunities like this, understand the likely buying situation, and reach the right person with a relevant message.



## Who We're Looking For



You should have hands-on experience with B2B outbound prospecting and appointment setting.



Experience with tools such as the following is preferred:



* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* Apollo or similar prospecting tools

* Cold
 platforms such as Smartlead or Instantly

*
 verification tools

* CRM systems

* LinkedIn outreach



Experience generating opportunities for **outsourcing, BPO, managed services, agencies, SaaS, or professional services** is a strong advantage.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands:



**Buying signal → right company → right decision-maker → relevant outreach → qualified conversation.**



## Please Answer These 3 Questions



**1. Tell me about one B2B campaign where you personally generated qualified appointments.**



What was being sold, who were you targeting, and approximately how many qualified meetings were you generating per month?



**2. What prospecting/outbound tools have you personally used?**



Apollo, Sales Navigator, Smartlead, Instantly, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, etc.



**3. Quick scenario:**



You find a 50-person US company currently hiring two Customer Support Representatives. We provide managed customer support capacity as an alternative to recruiting and managing additional internal staff.



**Who would you contact, and what would your outreach angle be?**



Please keep your answer to **3–5 sentences**.



## Paid Trial + Long-Term Opportunity



We will start with a **small paid trial** so we can evaluate how you research prospects, identify buying opportunities, choose decision-makers, and approach outbound strategy.



Strong performance can lead to a **long-term role with base compensation plus performance incentives** for qualified attended appointments and clients that close.



Our goal is not simply to hire someone who can send
s.



We want someone who can eventually **take ownership of our outbound lead generation and appointment-setting process**, continuously test and improve it, and help us build a predictable client acquisition system.



If you've actually done this before and can show us how you think, we'd love to hear from you.

Our audience includes executives, physicians, attorneys, founders, and other financially successful women. Our offerings include assessments, educational programs, memberships, and premium coaching experiences.



We’re hiring an experienced Media Buyer / Paid Ads Manager who can translate a distinctive brand and proven expertise into effective paid acquisition.



Your mission



Build and manage campaigns that attract the right women, generate qualified prospects, and support profitable customer acquisition.



We evaluate advertising through the full customer journey: assessment completion, purchases, qualified bookings, attended calls, and collected revenue. Lead quality matters as much as lead volume.



What you’ll own



- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Google, and Meta campaigns across
 and Instagram.

- Recommend additional channels, including Google or Pinterest, when the opportunity and economics justify testing.

- Develop acquisition and retargeting strategies for assessments, introductory offers, memberships, and qualified sales calls.

- Translate audience research into compelling campaign angles, hooks, and offers.

- Write ad copy and give our design and video team clear creative briefs, including concepts, scripts, visual direction, and variations.

- Monitor spending, campaign delivery, lead quality, and tracking daily; flag problems promptly.

- Audit conversion tracking and coordinate fixes with our technical team.

- Connect advertising data with CRM outcomes so we can follow prospects beyond the initial click or form submission.

- Work with marketing and sales to identify where prospects drop off and recommend practical improvements.

- Scale promising campaigns within approved budgets and agreed acquisition targets.

- Deliver a concise weekly report with results, findings, and recommended decisions.



You’ll work full time with our creative, sales, and technical teams. Your responsibility is to direct paid acquisition and identify what those teams need to help campaigns succeed.



What success looks like



- We consistently reach women who fit the offer.

- Qualified prospects move from interest to purchase or an attended sales conversation.

- We understand acquisition costs and collected revenue by campaign and offer.

- Creative testing produces useful learning and stronger campaigns.

- Spending decisions follow verified results and agreed targets.

- Leadership receives clear recommendations without having to chase updates.



Targets will be established from our actual funnel performance, offer economics, and approved budget. We expect you to help establish those baselines and explain your reasoning.



Who we’re looking for



- At least three years of hands-on paid advertising experience.

- Demonstrated results with coaching, education, memberships, premium services, or another business with a considered purchase journey.

- Strong Meta campaign management and direct-response copywriting skills.

- Experience attracting financially qualified buyers for premium offers.

- An understanding of creative strategy, landing-page conversion, lead qualification, and retargeting.

- Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution, and CRM reporting.

- The ability to distinguish a traffic problem from an offer, follow-up, booking, or sales problem.

- Sound judgment about advertising claims, customer privacy, and platform requirements.

- Clear written communication, reliable follow-through, and availability for scheduled meetings in U.S. Eastern Time.



Experience with Google Ads, Pinterest Ads, GoHighLevel, and app or subscription acquisition is a must. 



You’ll thrive here if



You combine analytical discipline with strong creative instincts. You understand how to speak to an accomplished woman without shaming her, diminishing her success, or making exaggerated promises.



You take ownership, explain your decisions clearly, and tell us when the evidence calls for a change. You respect the budget as carefully as you would your own.



Your first 30 days



- Audit the ad accounts, creative, funnel, tracking, and available historical results.

- Identify the biggest acquisition constraints and opportunities.

- Establish a reporting baseline and recommend initial acquisition targets.

- Present a prioritized testing plan with budget requirements.

title: Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager – Beauty Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role with an ambitious, fast-growing Australian beauty brand.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager to own and accelerate the brand’s direct-to-consumer growth. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can turn customer insight, creative ideas and performance data into stronger conversion, more efficient acquisition and sustained sales growth.



Focus: Ecommerce growth | Platform: Shopify | Channels: Paid, CRM and web



ABOUT THE BRAND



We are an age-positive Australian beauty brand creating high-performing, uncomplicated products for women who want beauty to feel relevant, joyful and real. We are building a distinctive brand with ambitious growth plans across Australia and international markets.



THE ROLE



You will lead the ecommerce growth engine across Shopify, paid media, CRM and onsite conversion. You will work closely with the social and creative teams to turn brand stories, customer problems and cultural moments into high-performing ads, hooks, landing pages and campaigns. You will be equally comfortable setting the strategy, briefing creative, managing activity in platform and digging into the numbers to d
 what happens next.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Ecommerce and Shopify ownership:

- Own the day-to-day performance and commercial growth of the brand’s Shopify store.

- Manage site merchandising, product launches, collections, promotions and campaign updates, ensuring the customer journey is seamless from landing page to checkout.

- Build and maintain a conversion optimisation roadmap across product pages, landing pages, bundles, offers, navigation, mobile experience and checkout.

- Use customer behaviour, site analytics and testing to identify friction, prioritise improvements and increase conversion rate and average order value.

- Coordinate developers and agency partners, writing clear briefs and ensuring work is delivered accurately and on time.



Paid media and profitable growth:

- Own paid performance strategy and execution across Meta and Google, including campaign structure, budgets, optimisation, testing and in-platform management.

- Set clear growth targets and manage spend against revenue, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, contribution margin and new-customer growth.

- Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, offers, formats, landing pages, hooks and creative concepts.

- Scale winning campaigns while protecting efficiency, and act quickly when performance changes.

- Translate channel data into clear actions and commercial recommendations for the leadership and wider team.



Creative strategy and campaign development:

- Work closely with social, brand and creative teams to build the advertising strategy, creative pipeline and campaign calendar.

- Develop sharp customer-led hooks, briefs and testing angles that connect the brand’s brand voice with clear product benefits and reasons to buy.

- Analyse creative performance to identify which messages, formats, talent and concepts drive sales, then feed those learnings back into content production.

- Write and refine on-brand copy for ads,
, landing pages and web campaigns.

- Ensure campaigns land consistently across paid ads, organic social,
, website and retail touchpoints.



CRM and customer growth:

- Own
 and CRM in Klaviyo, including campaign planning, automations, segmentation, testing, creative and reporting.

- Grow customer lifetime value through effective welcome, education, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and loyalty journeys.

- Use customer data and insights to improve retention, repeat purchase and the relevance of the brand’s communication.



Reporting, SEO and optimisation:

- Create a clear weekly trading and performance view covering revenue, traffic, conversion, average order value, channel efficiency, customer acquisition and retention.

- Own the digital trading rhythm, identifying risks and opportunities early and recommending the actions required to hit sales targets.

- Support SEO and content strategy, including the brand’s menopause and perimenopause education hub, working with agency partners and developers.

- Build a culture of testing and learning, with documented hypotheses, results and next steps.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Consistent, profitable growth in online revenue and new-customer acquisition.

- Improved Shopify conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- A reliable creative testing engine with a steady pipeline of new hooks and winning ad concepts.

- Stronger paid media efficiency and confident scaling of spend.

- Clear, actionable reporting that helps the team make faster commercial decisions.

- Well-executed launches and campaigns delivered seamlessly across all digital touchpoints.



ABOUT YOU



- Fluent English, spoken and written (essential)

- Senior ecommerce or growth marketing experience in a high-growth beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness or consumer brand, with a strong record of increasing online sales.

- Deep, hands-on Shopify experience and a strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising, customer journeys and conversion optimisation.

- Highly experienced in paid social and paid search, particularly Meta and Google, with the ability to manage campaigns directly rather than relying entirely on agencies.

- Experience applying proven ecommerce growth frameworks, with strong testing discipline and growth methodology.

- Strong Klaviyo and CRM experience across campaigns, automations, segmentation and retention strategy.

- A proven ability to use data to make decisions, prioritise activity and explain performance clearly to non-specialists.

- Strong creative judgement and experience partnering with social and creative teams to develop performance-led concepts, hooks and briefs.

- Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with a sharp understanding of brand tone and customer motivation.

- Commercially minded, highly organised and comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Proactive, accountable and calm under pressure, with the confidence to challenge, recommend and act.



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Experience growing a beauty brand across Australia and the United States.

- Experience with subscription, bundles, gifting, loyalty or referral programs.

- Working knowledge of GA4, attribution tools, dashboards, SEO and Shopify analytics.

- Experience managing agency, freelance and developer relationships.



HOW WE WORK



This role suits someone who loves pace, ownership and visible commercial impact. You will be expected to bring ideas, test them quickly, learn from the results and work generously across brand, creative, social and operations. Here, strong performance and strong brand building should reinforce each other.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and a short note outlining the ecommerce growth you have personally driven. Include examples of Shopify conversion improvements, paid media results, creative testing programs and the ecommerce growth frameworks you have used.
